item.title: President Lee: "Tax Normalization, Not Housing Prices… Reforms Fail If They Are Too Noisy" (이 대통령 “집값보다 조세 정상화…개혁은 요란하면 실패”)
item.description:
Ahead of the real estate grand debate scheduled for the 23rd, President Lee Jae-myung emphasized equity in real estate taxation, stating, "We are not taxing to curb housing prices." He also stressed the importance of persuasion and consensus in the reform process, saying, "If you shout loudly and make a lot of noise, it's difficult to achieve results." (이재명 대통령이 오는 23일 부동산 대토론회를 앞두고 “집값을 잡으려고 세금을 하는 것 아니다”라며 부동산 세제 형평성을 강조했다. 이 대통령은 또 “소리를 많이 지르고 요란하게 하면 성과를 내기 어렵다”며 개혁 추진 과정에서의 설득과 공감을 강조했다.)

During a cabinet meeting presided over by the President at the Blue House on the 14th, Lee noted, "The tax system in the housing sector has become highly distorted and deformed. With too many deductions and exemptions, it has been so heavily modified that it no longer serves its basic functions. As a result, it has even become a factor stimulating real estate speculation, making normalization necessary." He added, "Suppressing housing prices is not the primary goal; 'normalization' is the first objective, and the second is to mitigate the side effects that foster speculation. I hope people understand this. 'Equitable taxation' is most important, while housing price stabilization is a secondary effect." This is interpreted as an intention to overhaul real estate taxation not as a tool for price stabilization but from the perspective of restoring tax equity and normalizing the tax system. (이 대통령은 14일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “지금 주택 분야에서 조세제도가 많이 왜곡되고, 변형돼 있다”며 “뭐 이렇게 공제해주고, 저렇게 빼주고 해서 너무 많이 변형해서 조세의 기본적 기능을 못 하고 있다. 그러다 보니 오히려 부동산 투기 유발 요인이 돼버려 정상화가 필요하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “집값을 눌러보겠다는 게 1차 목표는 아니고 ‘정상화’가 1차 목표고, 두번째는 부수적인 투기 유발 부작용을 좀 완화해야겠다는 점을 좀 이해해주면 좋겠다”며 “‘형평성 있는 조세’가 제일 중요하고 집값 안정은 부수적 효과”라고 말했다. 부동산 세제를 집값 안정 수단이 아니라 조세 형평성 회복과 세제 정상화 관점에서 손질하겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 것으로 풀이된다.)

During the cabinet meeting, which was live-streamed on YouTube, President Lee conducted an "instant poll" via comments, asking whether there should be additional holding taxes for ultra-high-value single-home owners. Midway through the meeting, he spontaneously proposed, "To the citizens watching, if you own a single residence for actual living but agree with imposing additional holding burdens on ultra-high-value homes, please write '1' in the comments; if not, write '2'." He then spent a minute reviewing the comments streaming on the live broadcast. Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, reported, "About 90% of comments were in favor of the additional burden, while about 10% were against." (이 대통령은 유튜브로 생중계되는 국무회의에서 초고가 1주택 추가 보유세 부담 여부를 댓글로 묻는 ‘즉석투표’를 하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 회의 도중 “방송 보시는 국민 여러분 중에 실거주 1주택인데, 초고가 주택에 대해선 통상적인 보호보다는 추가 보유 부담을 하는 데 동의하면 1번, 아니면 2번을 (댓글로) 써달라”고 즉석 제안한 뒤 1분간 국무회의 생중계에 달리는 댓글을 살폈다. 임기근 국무조정실장은 “추가 부담에 찬성하는 의견이 약 90%, 반대가 약 10%였다”고 말했다.)

President Lee further suggested, "What if we set a threshold for the additional burden, like 2 billion, 3 billion, or 4 billion won? Let's see which gets the most votes." When Director Im noted "3 billion won (received the most support)," Lee responded, "Unexpected; I thought it would be 5 billion." The government plans to hold open discussions on supply, finance, and taxation from today, followed by a 'National Grand Debate on Real Estate Policy' on the 23rd, which President Lee will attend. (이 대통령은 또 “얼마 이상부터 추가 부담을 부과할지 20억, 30억, 40억원 앞글자를 눌러보시면 어떻겠나 싶다”고 말했다. 임 실장이 “30억이 (제일 많다)”고 하자 이 대통령은 “의외네, 50억은 할 줄 알았는데”라고 답했다. 정부는 이날부터 공급·금융·세제를 주제로 공개 토론을 진행한 뒤 23일 이 대통령이 참석하는 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’를 열 예정이다.)

President Lee also actively countered criticisms that the government focuses solely on growth, neglecting reform and welfare. (이 대통령은 정부가 성장에만 치중해 개혁과 복지를 소홀히 한다는 일각의 지적도 적극 반박했다.)

"Recently, there seems to be talk that the Lee Jae-myung administration is too focused on growth and the economy, neglecting reform and turning its back on welfare," Lee said. "But we are continuously expanding welfare policies as needed." He likened reform to an injection, explaining, "Shouting loudly and making a fuss might seem impressive, but it strengthens resistance and makes it hard to achieve results." He continued, "I once had hives and went to a pharmacy run by a senior. Just as the needle was about to go in, I tensed up from fear, and the syringe broke. Reform is similar. We need to persuade, minimize pain, gain consensus on legitimacy from many people, and proceed step by step effectively, so that at some point, people realize things have changed." (이 대통령은 “최근 개혁과 관련해 이재명 정부가 너무 성장과 경제 얘기만 한다, 개혁을 소홀히 하는 거 아니냐, 복지를 외면하는 거 아니냐는 얘기를 하는 거 같다”며 “복지 정책은 필요한 만큼 계속 확장해 나가고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 “소리를 많이 지르고, 요란하게 하면 멋있을지는 몰라도 그렇게 하면 저항 강도가 세지고 성과를 내기가 어렵다”며 개혁을 ‘주사’에 빗대 설명하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 “과거 제가 두드러기가 올라와 선배가 있는 약국에 갔다. 주사를 탁 찌르려는 순간에 겁이 나서 힘을 줬더니 주사기가 부러졌다”며 “개혁도 비슷하다. 설득하고, 고통을 최소화하고, 정당성에 대해 많은 사람들의 공감을 얻고 순차적으로 실효적으로 해서 ‘어느 순간 보니까 바뀌었네’ 이렇게 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

While President Lee's remarks on that day were made in the context of emphasizing that social reforms are not being neglected, some interpreted them as a reference to the conflict within the Democratic Party over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights. A ruling party official commented, "I think the point is that instead of labeling those with different opinions as anti-reform over the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, we should gather various views and move forward." (이 대통령의 이날 발언은 사회개혁도 소홀히 하지 않는다는 점을 강조하는 맥락에서 나왔지만, 더불어민주당 내 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 갈등을 지적한 것이라는 해석도 나왔다. 한 여권 관계자는 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 두고 자기 의견과 다르다고 반개혁적이라고 몰아붙일 게 아니라 서로 의견을 수렴해서 추진해야 한다는 취지의 (말씀) 아니겠냐”라고 말했다.)

Regarding Mifepristone, an abortion pill not legally available in South Korea, President Lee stated, "The government's current neglect is irresponsible. Even before alternative legislation is prepared, there could be ways to allow doctors to use their discretion in prescribing it," and instructed relevant ministries to discuss the matter. (이 대통령은 국내에선 합법적으로 구할 수 없는 먹는 임신중단약 미프진에 대해 “정부가 지금처럼 방치하는 것은 무책임하다”며 “대체 입법이 마련되기 전이라도 의사가 재량으로 처방 여부를 판단하도록 하는 방법도 있을 것 같다”며 관련 부처 협의를 지시했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji: yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "The age threshold for juvenile offenders should indeed be lowered… Let's discuss it once more" (이 대통령 “촉법소년 연령 기준, 낮추긴 낮춰야…또 한번 토론하자”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th that regarding the issue of lowering the age of criminal minors (juvenile offenders), "it should indeed be lowered," but he withheld a final decision at the Cabinet meeting. (이재명 대통령은 14일 형사미성년자(촉법소년) 연령 하향 문제에 관해 “낮추긴 낮춰야 한다”면서도 국무회의 최종 결정은 유보했다.)

At the Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office that day, after receiving a report from Minister of Gender Equality and Family Won Min-kyung on the results of a public discussion on lowering the age threshold for juvenile offenders, President Lee said, "Let's discuss once more whether to lower it partially, fully, for all crimes, by one year, or by two years, and also conduct public opinion surveys to gather citizens' views. It's a difficult topic, so let's not make a final decision today." Juvenile offenders refer to criminal minors aged 10 to 14 who, despite committing crimes, are exempt from criminal punishment. <<> Based on the public discussion results at the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family meeting, a plan was proposed to lower the age threshold for juvenile offenders to 'ages 10 to under 13'—a one-year reduction—but only for violent, serious, and repeat offenses. This comes four months after President Lee ordered a public discussion on lowering the juvenile offender age threshold at a Cabinet meeting in February. <<> President Lee said, "(Looking at media reports), there are cases where they say, 'I'm a juvenile offender, so I won't be punished,' and then commit crimes. When you see that, you wonder if a one-year reduction is enough. Can't a 12-year-old knowingly commit murder or a serious crime?" He added, "The Ministry of Gender Equality's opinion is not to lower it uniformly but only partially for specific crimes by one year—doesn't that seem too, too weak? Globally, isn't it quite common to set the juvenile offender age at 12?" This is interpreted as suggesting that the extent of lowering the juvenile offender age should be greater than the ministry's proposal, or that a uniform reduction should be considered. President Lee added, "The maximum reduction seems to be two years." <<> President Lee also mentioned that even juvenile offenders can be sent to juvenile detention centers for up to two years, saying, "It's not that juvenile offenders are completely unpunished currently. Some people think they face no punishment at all, so we'll listen to opinions once more." <<> By reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 원민경 성평등가족부 장관에게 촉법소년 연령 기준 하향 공론화 결과를 보고받은 뒤 “부분적으로 낮출 거냐, 전면적으로 낮출 거냐, 모든 범죄에 낮출 거냐, 1년 낮출 거냐, 2년 낮출 거냐 등에 대해 또 한번 토론해보고 여론조사 등 국민 의견 수렴도 해보자”며 “어려운 주제인데 오늘 최종 결정하지 말자”고 말했다. 촉법소년은 범죄를 저질렀지만 형사처벌은 면제받는 ‘만 10살 이상 14살 미만’의 형사미성년자를 뜻한다.)

item.title: Democratic Party’s plan for a direct election of a youth supreme council member fails due to opposition from Pro-Chung faction… backlash grows over “collective self-serving politics” (친청계 반대에 민주 ‘직선 청년 최고위원’ 무산…“집단적 자기정치” 반발 확산)
item.description:
The Supreme Council of the Democratic Party of Korea voted down the "plan to separately elect a youth supreme council member" on the 14th, sparking internal criticism. (더불어민주당 최고위원회가 14일 ‘청년최고위원 분리 선출안’을 부결시킨 것을 두고 당내 비판이 쏟아졌다.)

Kim Min-seok, a former prime minister running in the party leadership election, wrote on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "It is regrettable that the introduction of a youth supreme council member, which would broaden the path for youth politics, was thwarted by opposition from a specific candidate’s camp," and criticized it as "collective self-serving politics that prioritized small gains over the greater good." Lawmaker Song Young-gil also pointed out, "The self-serving politics of certain supreme council members have been disrupting the party convention, and now they’ve swallowed up even the youth’s place." Lawmaker Ko Min-jung noted, "How can we explain to the people that we trampled on our own proposed alternative for the sake of factional infighting and a handful of power?" Kim Yong, a former deputy director of the Democratic Party Research Institute running for the supreme council, also expressed regret, saying, "They erased the space to build a new pillar to protect their own bowls." (당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리는 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “청년 정치의 길을 넓히는 청년최고위원 도입이 특정 후보 측 반대로 무산되어 아쉽다”며 “대의보다 작은 이익을 앞세운 집단적 자기 정치”라고 비판했다. 송영길 의원도 “특정 최고위원들의 자기 정치가 전당대회를 어지럽히더니, 끝내 청년의 자리까지 집어삼켰다”고 꼬집었다. 고민정 의원은 “계파 간 다툼, 한줌 권력을 위해 우리 스스로 제시한 대안을 걷어찬 것에 대해 국민들께 무슨 말씀을 드릴 수 있겠느냐”고 지적했다. 최고위원 후보로 나선 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장도 “제 밥그릇 지키겠다고 새 기둥 세울 자리를 지워버렸다”고 아쉬움을 표했다.)

Earlier, on the 9th, the party’s convention preparation committee (CPC) decided to separate one of the five elected supreme council members as a youth seat and reported the agenda to the Supreme Council. However, during the Supreme Council meeting that day, figures classified as the Pro-Chung (Chung Cheong-rae) faction voted against it, leading to its rejection. While former Prime Minister Kim and Lawmaker Song had pledged to institutionalize the elected youth supreme council member system, former representative Chung Cheong-rae had stated he would appoint one of the two supreme council members nominated by the party leader as a youth member. On that day as well, Chung expressed his position, saying, "The youth supreme council member system lacks relevant party constitution and rules," and "Without any legal basis, even if the CPC resolves it, it’s not a valid resolution." Around the party, there are many assessments that the Pro-Chung faction lacks suitable candidates to put forward as youth supreme council members. (앞서 지난 9일 민주당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)는 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 1명을 청년 몫으로 분리 선출하기로 결정하고 해당 안건을 최고위에 보고했으나, 이날 최고위 회의에서 친청(정청래)계로 분류되는 인사들이 반대표를 던져 부결시켰다. 김 전 총리와 송 의원은 선출직 청년최고위원제의 제도화를 공약한 반면, 정청래 전 대표는 당대표가 지명하는 최고위원 2명 중 1명을 청년으로 임명하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다. 정 전 대표는 이날에도 “청년최고위원제는 (관련한) 당헌·당규가 없다”며 “근거 조항이 없는데 전준위에서 의결한들 의결한 게 아니다”라는 입장을 밝혔다. 당 주변에서는 친청계에서 청년최고위원 후보로 내세울 인물이 마땅치 않다는 평이 많다.)

Criticism also erupted from within the party’s youth organization. Lawmaker Mo Kyung-jong, the chairman of the Democratic Party’s National Youth Committee and a CPC member, met with reporters that day and stated, "It’s regrettable that the CPC’s decision was not respected by the Supreme Council," and added, "I hope the new leadership will amend the party constitution as quickly as possible to address the situation where the youth supreme council member system was not implemented due to a lack of time for preparation." Bong Geon-woo, chairman of the Democratic Party’s National University Student Committee, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and announced his resignation from the party’s election management committee, saying, "This was supposed to be the starting point for change to restore youth sentiment, but it ultimately fell through." (당내 청년 조직에서도 비판이 터져나왔다. 민주당 전국청년위원장이자 전준위 위원인 모경종 의원은 이날 기자들을 만나 “전준위 의결을 최고위에서 존중받지 못해서 유감”이라며 “시기상 (준비 시간이) 부족하다는 이유로 청년최고위원제가 도입되지 못한 상황을 보완하기 위한 당헌 개정을 새 지도부에서 최대한 빨리 해주길 바란다”고 말했다. 봉건우 민주당 전국대학생위원장은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “청년 민심 회복을 위한 변화의 출발점이었는데 끝내 무산됐다”며 당 선거관리위원에서 사퇴한다고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Decides to Introduce ‘Preferential Voting System’ for Party Leader Election…‘Opponent’ Jeong Cheong-rae Says “I Accept” (민주, 당대표 선거에 ‘선호투표제’ 도입키로…‘반대’ 정청래 “수용한다”)
item.description:
The leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea decided on the 14th to introduce a preferential voting system for the election of the party leader at the August 17 national convention. This marks the conclusion of the rules after a week of turmoil following the decision by the National Convention Preparation Committee on the 7th to adopt the system. (더불어민주당 지도부가 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 선호투표제를 도입하기로 14일 결정했다. 지난 7일 전당대회준비위원회가 도입을 결정한 뒤 일주일간의 진통 끝에 규칙을 일단 매듭지은 것이다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon announced the decision to introduce the preferential voting system during a briefing after a closed-door Supreme Council meeting on the morning of the same day, stating, “Ahead of the national convention, we have decided to amend the party rules to minimize controversy over violations related to the election of the leadership.” He added, “We have decided to stipulate in the party rules that either the preferential voting system or a runoff voting system can be used as a method for conducting a runoff election.” During this process, Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, a close ally of Jeong Cheong-rae, resigned from his post in protest. The preferential voting system is a method used when three or more candidates are running and no candidate secures a majority of votes. In such cases, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and their second-preference votes are added to the totals of the top two candidates, determining the final winner on the same day. (강준현 수석대변인은 이날 오전 비공개 최고위원회 뒤 브리핑에서 선호투표제 도입 결정을 발표하며 “전당대회를 앞두고 지도부 선출과 관련해 규정 (위반) 논란을 최소화하기 위해 당규를 개정하기로 했다”며 “(당규에) 결선투표 실시 방법으로 선호투표제와 결선투표제를 할 수 있음을 명문화하기로 했다”고 말했다. 이 과정에서 친정청래계인 이성윤 최고위원은 반발해 직을 사퇴했다. 선호투표제는 3명 이상의 후보자가 출마했을 때 과반 득표자가 안 나올 경우 최하위 득표자를 탈락시킨 뒤 그가 얻은 2순위 표를 1·2위 후보에게 합산해 당일 최종 당선자를 결정하는 방식이다.)

Article 66 of the Democratic Party’s rules states: ‘The party leader election shall have a candidate with a majority of votes as the winner. Specific methods for conducting a runoff election for this purpose shall be determined by the National Convention Preparation Committee and finalized through approval by the Supreme Council and the Party Affairs Committee.’ This clause has been amended to read: ‘If there are three or more candidates in the primary, either the preferential voting system or a runoff voting system shall be chosen and implemented to determine a majority vote winner.’ Former leader Jeong Cheong-rae’s faction had previously objected, arguing that the preferential voting system, which is not specified in the party constitution or rules, has potential for violating them. (민주당 당규 66조엔 ‘당 대표 선거는 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시의 구체적 방식은 전당대회준비위원회에서 정하고 최고위와 당무위원회 의결로 확정한다’고 돼 있는데 이 조항을 “경선 후보자가 3인 이상이면 과반수 득표자 결정을 위해 선호투표 또는 결선투표 중 하나를 정해 실시한다”로 바꾼 것이다. 정청래 전 대표 쪽은 그동안 당헌·당규에 명시되지 않은 선호투표제는 당헌·당규 위반 소지가 있다고 반발해왔다.)

After the Supreme Council’s decision, major contenders for the party leadership announced their acceptance. Former leader Jeong wrote on Facebook that day, “I coolly accept the party’s decision.” He later told reporters at the National Assembly, “If a lawsuit is filed later, the (convention) results could be invalidated, so I demanded that the possibility of violating the party constitution and rules be resolved.” Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil also responded, respectively: “It’s better not to have candidates arguing over the rules,” and “It has been well organized, as I have consistently argued.” (최고위 결정 뒤 주요 당권 주자들은 수용하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “당의 결정을 쿨하게 수용한다”고 썼다. 그는 이후 국회에서 기자들에게 “나중에 소송이 걸리면 (전대 결과가) 무효가 될 수 있기 때문에 당헌·당규 위반 소지를 해소해달라고 요구한 것”이라고 말했다. 김민석 전 총리와 송영길 의원도 각각 “룰을 갖고 선수들은 이야기 안 하는 게 좋다”, “제가 일관되게 주장했던 대로 잘 정리됐다”고 반응했다.)

It is known that Acting Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do, who also serves as the party’s representative, has been persuading opponents like former leader Jeong behind the scenes to finalize the introduction of the preferential voting system before the two-day candidate registration period (August 16-17) for the upcoming convention begins. In this process, former leader Jeong indicated on the 13th, “If the issue of violating the party constitution and rules is resolved, I will follow whatever decision is made,” signaling acceptance on the condition of amending the party rules. Former leader Jeong was also under pressure to avoid disruptions to the convention schedule due to his opposition. After the decision on the preferential voting system, he said, “The national convention is imminent, and continued chaos could lead to various side effects, so I respect and accept it for the greater good.” Additionally, it is known that former leader Jeong’s faction views the preferential voting and runoff voting systems as unlikely to overturn the election outcome. (한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이틀 앞으로 다가온 전당대회 후보등록(16∼17일) 시작 전에 선호투표제 도입을 마무리하려 이에 반발하는 정 전 대표 등을 물밑 설득해온 것으로 알려졌다. 이 과정에서 정 전 대표는 지난 13일 “당헌·당규 (위반) 문제가 해소되면 어떤 결정을 하든 따르겠다”며 당규 개정을 전제로 한 수용 의사를 표시했다. 정 전 대표로서는 자신의 반대 탓에 전대 일정에 차질이 생기는 데 대한 부담도 없지 않았다. 그는 선호투표제 결정 뒤 “전당대회가 코앞에 있고 혼란이 계속되면 여러 부작용이 있기 때문에 대승적 차원에서 존중하고 수용한다”고 했다. 아울러 정 전 대표 쪽은 선호투표와 결선투표가 승패 결과를 뒤바꿀 만한 변수는 아니라고 보는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Meanwhile, the introduction of a system to elect a youth supreme council member by separating one of the five elected supreme council seats was rejected after a vote in the Supreme Council. It was understood that Supreme Council members Park Gyu-hwan, Moon Jung-bok, and Park Ji-won, who are aligned with the pro-Jeong faction, led the rejection. A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented to the Hankyoreh, “It seems former leader Jeong’s faction placed importance on being able to form a majority Supreme Council (which would exclude an unfriendly youth supreme council member if he is elected party leader).” (한편, 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 1명을 청년최고위원으로 분리해 뽑는 선출직 청년최고위원제 도입은 최고위원회 표결 끝에 부결됐다. 친청계 최고위원인 박규환, 문정복, 박지원 최고위원 등이 부결을 이끈 것으로 파악됐다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 한겨레에 “정 전 대표 쪽은 (자신이 당대표에 당선됐을 때 비우호적인 청년최고위원이 포함되지 않은) 과반 최고위를 구성할 수 있을지를 중요하게 본 것 같다”고 평했다.)

item.title: "Need to Retain Some Supplementary Investigation Powers" – Cautious Approach Emerges at DP Assembly…"Debate Continues" (“보완수사권 일부 존치 필요” 신중론 나온 민주 의총…“토론 계속”)
item.description:
At the Democratic Party of Korea's general meeting of lawmakers held on the 14th, a cautious stance was raised that supplementary investigation powers should be retained on an exceptional basis, amid the debate over abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative authority. The 'Gwangju high school student murder case' appears to have influenced public criticism of the complete abolition of these powers, adding pressure. <<> Kim Han-kyu, senior deputy chief of policy coordination at the party, reported on the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act proposed by the party's task force on the 9th during the National Assembly lawmakers' meeting. The bill's core is to completely abolish prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers while controlling police abuse of investigative authority. After the report, Rep. Hong Ki-won took the podium to explain his own proposed amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act. This bill includes provisions to maintain supplementary investigation powers for crimes targeting socially vulnerable groups and crimes infringing on public welfare. Eleven lawmakers, including Hong Ki-won, Ko Min-jeong, Kwak Sang-eon, Kim Nam-hee, Mo Gyeong-jong, Moon Jin-seok, Min Hong-cheol, Park Gyun-taek, Park Hee-seung, Lee So-young, and Ju Cheol-hyeon, have signed onto the bill. <<> Over the two-hour meeting, 15 lawmakers spoke. Among them, 10, including Reps. Hong Ki-won, Park Gyun-taek, and Lee So-young, expressed that the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers should be approached cautiously, considering side effects. Rep. Ko Min-jeong also told reporters, "There are concerns from some quarters that (the abolition of supplementary investigation powers) may leave gaps in investigations of sexual violence, child abuse, and cases involving persons with disabilities. We should implement the abolition only when it becomes clear how to address those issues." Reps. Kim Dong-ah and Lee Sang-sik reportedly suggested that even if the powers are abolished, measures could include allowing prosecutors to be involved in investigations from the start or granting them authority to verify facts to mitigate side effects. <<> Voices also called for a swift decision to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers. <<> Rep. Kim Yong-min, who jointly proposed a bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers with Rep. Park Eun-jeong of the Fatherland Innovation Party on the 26th of last month, reportedly said, "A political decision is needed to abolish supplementary investigation powers." After the meeting, he held a press conference and criticized, "According to Rep. Hong Ki-won's (proposed amendment), it would make possible targeted investigations by prosecutors and an unlimited expansion of investigative authority." <<> After the meeting, Deputy Spokesperson Lee Joo-hee told reporters, "There doesn't seem to be any opinion within the party to fully retain supplementary investigation powers," adding, "There were a few opinions on whether to allow some powers on an exceptional and limited basis. Lawmakers particularly gave much thought to the issue of socially vulnerable groups." <<> Party leadership contender Chung Cheong-rae, a former party leader, shared on Facebook an article reporting that 10 lawmakers had indicated a cautious stance on abolishing supplementary investigation powers at the meeting, writing, "This is really serious. I feel depressed about why this atmosphere has suddenly emerged." <<> The Democratic Party plans to invite experts next week to hold a policy meeting of lawmakers and continue the discussion. Floor Leader Park Chan-dae said in his opening remarks at the meeting, "We must complete the last piece of prosecutorial reform by amending the Criminal Procedure Act to completely abolish supplementary investigation powers," and added, "I hope we can finalize a criminal justice system for the people through sufficient deliberation and intense debate." <<> Jeong Hye-min, Kim Chae-woon, Jo Hee-yeon, and Choi Ha-yan, reporters jhm@hani.co.kr (검사 보완수사권 폐지 문제를 두고 14일 열린 더불어민주당 의원총회에서 예외적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다는 ‘신중론’이 제기됐다. ‘광주 고교생 살해사건’을 계기로 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 대한 비판 여론이 영향을 미친 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil criticizes Chung Cheong-rae, saying “It feels like looking down on the president” and uses “abortion” in his critique (송영길, 정청래에 “대통령 깔보는 느낌”…“낙태” 써가며 비판)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized former representative Chung Cheong-rae’s remarks about regretting the nomination in Pyeongtaek-eul, calling them “extremely irresponsible” and stating, “It’s like saying to your son, ‘I should have aborted you, but I gave birth to you instead.’” (송영길 더불어민주당 의원은 정청래 전 대표의 ‘평택을 공천 후회’ 취지의 발언에 대해 “너무 무책임하다”며 “예를 들어서 자기 아들한테 ‘내가 너 낙태했어야 되는데 낳아서’ 그런 거하고 똑같은 것”이라고 말했다.)

Appearing on MBC Radio’s “Kim Jong-bae’s Focus” on the 15th, Song reignited the issue of responsibility for the local elections, saying, “By absorbing every issue into the Pyeongtaek election, we lost all the clear strengths we had in this local election.” Even after the host noted that the “abortion” analogy was inappropriate, Song insisted, “It’s exactly the same. What about the party members who supported Kim Yong-nam (the Democratic Party candidate at the time) as the regional committee chair?” (송 의원은 15일 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “모든 이슈를 평택 선거가 빨아들임으로써 이번 지방선거에서 선명한 우리 강점의 이슈를 다 놓쳐버렸다”며 지방선거 책임론을 다시 꺼냈다. 특히 송 의원은 ‘낙태’ 발언에 대해 진행자가 “비유가 좀 그렇다”고 지적했음에도 “그런 거하고 똑같은 거다. 당시 (더불어민주당 후보였던) 김용남 지역위원장을 지지한 당원들은 어떻게 되는 거냐”고 했다.)

Song also said, “Former representative Chung Cheong-rae and I became lawmakers before President Lee Jae-myung. Since we entered politics earlier, there’s a feeling that (Chung) is somewhat looking down on the president.” (송 의원은 또 “정청래 전 대표나 저나 이재명 대통령보다 먼저 국회의원이 됐고, 정치로서는 먼저 되다 보니까 (정 전 대표가) 뭔가 대통령을 약간 깔본다고 그럴까 하는 느낌이 있다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, on the previous day, Chung appeared on YouTube’s “Kim Eo-joon’s News Factory” and expressed regret over the Democratic Party fielding a candidate in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, which was contested by Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, saying, “I often think about how it might have been if the merger with the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had succeeded before the local elections.” (앞서, 정 전 대표는 전날 유튜브 ‘김어준의 뉴스공장’ 에 출연해 “지방선거 전에 (조국혁신당과의) 합당이 성공했으면 어땠을까 하는 생각도 많이 하게 된다”며 당시 조국 조국혁신당 대표가 출마한 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 민주당 후보를 낸 것을 후회한다는 취지의 발언을 했다.)

Park Ji-won (five-term lawmaker) of the Democratic Party appeared on YTN’s “Jang Sung-chul’s News Myeongdang” on the same day and said, “I think it’s possible to have regrets. But even if you feel that way inside, I think that’s something you shouldn’t express.” (박지원(5선) 민주당 의원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “후회할 수 있다고 본다. 하지만 마음 속으로 (후회를) 하더라도 그 표현을 해서는 안 되는 내용이라고 본다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party "Will Push for Hearing on Homeplus Crisis… MBK and Meritz Only Focus on Evading Responsibility" (민주당 “홈플러스 사태 청문회 추진…MBK·메리츠, 책임 회피만 골몰”)
item.description:
Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 15th, "The Democratic Party will push for a hearing on the Homeplus crisis." (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 15일 “민주당은 홈플러스 사태 청문회를 추진하겠다”라고 밝혔다.)

During a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that morning, Acting Leader Han said, "The Homeplus crisis is causing enormous damage to 13,000 workers and their families, as well as to tenant and supplier companies, and further to local communities, consumers, and the people," adding, "Even though bankruptcy proceedings are imminent, MBK and Meritz remain passive and solely focused on evading responsibility." (한 직무대행은 이날 오전 국회 최고위원회의에서 “(홈플러스 사태로) 1만3천여명의 노동자와 그 가족, 입점 업체와 납품 업체, 나아가 지역사회와 소비자, 국민에게도 막대한 피해가 돌아간다”며 “파산 절차가 코앞으로 다가왔음에도 불구하고, 엠비케이(MBK)와 메리츠는 여전히 소극적인 태도로 책임 회피에만 골몰하고 있다”라고 말했다.)

He continued, "Yesterday, I instructed Park Sang-hyuk, the secretary of the Political Affairs Committee, to immediately hold a hearing to thoroughly investigate the truth of this incident," emphasizing, "The Democratic Party will do its utmost to uncover the truth, punish those responsible, and protect workers' livelihoods, support related businesses, and safeguard local economies." (이어 “저는 어제 박상혁 정무위 간사에게 즉각 청문회를 개최하여 이번 사태의 진상을 낱낱이 규명할 것을 지시했다”면서 “민주당은 진상 규명과 책임자 처벌, 나아가 노동자의 생존권 사수와 관련 업체의 지원, 지역 경제 보호에도 끝까지 노력을 다하겠다”라고 강조했다.)

Turning to the People Power Party, he urged, "In the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, they defended the Yoon Seok-yeol insurrection and paralyzed the Assembly with indiscriminate filibustering. In the second half, they have even refused to form the Assembly's leadership, bringing its operations to a halt," demanding, "Cooperate immediately in forming the Assembly's leadership." (또 국민의힘을 향해서는 “22대 국회 전반기에는 윤석열 내란을 옹호하고, 무차별적인 필리버스터로 국회를 마비시키더니, 후반기에는 원 구성조차 거부하며 국회 운영을 멈춰 세웠다”며 “즉시 원 구성에 협조하라”라고 촉구했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, "We intend to proceed even if the People Power Party does not attend." He stated that a hearing is planned for the 27th. (강준현 수석대변인은 최고위원회 뒤 기자와 만나 “국민의힘이 참석하지 않더라도 추진하려 한다”고 밝혔다. 강 수석대변인은 오는 27일 청문회 개최를 계획하고 있다고 전했다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-oh: "Jang Dong-hyuk's 'Take It or Leave It' Attitude Is Like a Gangster... He Should Quit Not Just as Party Leader but as a Lawmaker" (이재오 “장동혁 ‘배 째라’는 건달이나…대표 아니라 의원도 그만둬야”)
item.description:
Lee Jae-oh, senior adviser to the People Power Party (PPP), said of PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, "He shouldn't just step down as party leader—he should resign as a member of the National Assembly." He argued that after the June 3 local elections, "It's unthinkable to lose and still stubbornly say, 'Take it or leave it.'" (이재오 국민의힘 상임고문이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 향해 “대표만 그만두는 게 아니라 국회의원을 던져야 된다”고 말했다. 6·3 지방선거 뒤 “져놓고도 ‘배 째라’라고 버티는 건 있을 수도 없는 일”이라는 것이다.)

Lee, who serves as chairman of the Korea Democracy Foundation, appeared on CBS Radio's "Park Jae-hong's One-Round Show" on the 14th and stated, "In politics, whether you're the ruling party or the opposition, after a major election, the party leader, regardless of their term, typically says they've done their part and steps down—that's the custom." He added, "But losing and then insisting on a 'take it or leave it' attitude is something from a back alley; it's hard to even talk about." When the host asked, "Like a gangster?" Lee nodded lightly and said, "That (refusing to resign) is truly unacceptable." (민주화운동기념사업회 이사장을 맡고 있는 이 고문은 14일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’에 나와 “여당이든 야당이든 큰 선거가 끝나면 당 대표였던 사람은 임기와 관계없이 내 역할을 다했으니까 그만둔다 하는 게 정치의 관례”라며 “근데 져놓고도 ‘배 째라’라고 버티는 건 뒷골목, 참 말하기 뭐하지만”이라고 했다. 진행자가 “건달?”이라고 하자 이 고문은 가볍게 고개를 끄덕인 뒤 “그거(사퇴를 안 하는 것)는 진짜 있을 수도 없는 일”이라고 했다.)

Lee noted, "If someone digs in like that with a 'take it or leave it' attitude, the party will gradually collapse." He urged, "Representative Jang, you seem a bit intoxicated now—pull yourself together and announce your resignation." He continued, "If the election has been such a disaster, I believe he should not only step down as party leader but also resign as a lawmaker. He should leave his seat in the Assembly and go back to run in his hometown election to relearn politics. That's the political leadership expected of someone who once led the party." (이 고문은 “저렇게 ‘배 째라’고 눌러앉아 있으면 당은 점점 망하는 것”이라며 “(장 대표가) 지금 뭐가 좀 취해있는데, 정신 차리고 그만두겠다 (해야 한다)”고 했다. 이어 “저렇게 이번 선거에 망했으면 대표만 그만두는 게 아니라 국회의원을 던져야 된다고 본다”며 “국회의원까지 그만두고 ‘정치를 내 고향 선거에 가서 다시 배워오겠다' 그런 자세로 다시 그만둬야 한다. 그게 한때나마 대표를 했던 사람의 정치적 리더십”이라고도 했다.)

Lee warned, "If the PPP persists like this, it will suffer a crushing defeat in the general election two years from now. The question is whether the party is dismantled now or later." He added, "To avoid dismantling and instead repair things, the leader should step down, the leadership should resign too—not just the leader, but also the supreme council members. We need to show a fresh start for the party; only then might the public consider trusting us once more." Lee concluded, "The party is now even destroying the last hope of the people." (이 고문은 “국민의힘이 저렇게 버티면 내후년 총선에 참패한다. 당을 지금 해체하느냐, 그때 해체하느냐의 차이”라며 “해체 안 하고 수선하려면 대표라도 그만두고, 우리 지도부도 물러난다, 대표뿐만 아니라 무슨 최고위원들도 그만두고 새롭게 당이 출발해야 되겠다, 이런 거라도 보여줘야 국민들이 그래도 좀 한번 믿어볼까 (한다)”고 했다. 이 고문은 “이제는 국민들 마지막 희망마저 당이 없애고 있는 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Jang's "disciplinary politics," Lee pointed out, "The non-mainstream within the party says 'step down' whenever they feel like it. But is it grounds for discipline just because someone says 'step down' or curses the leader?" He criticized, "What Jang Dong-hyuk is doing doesn't strengthen party discipline. It's actually a lack of discipline when the person who should leave doesn't leave. What kind of discipline is that?" (장 대표의 ‘징계 정치’와 관련해 이 고문은 “(당내) 비주류는 심심하면 ‘대표 내려오라’고 한다”며 “그런데 무슨 ‘대표 내려오라’ 그랬다고, 대표 욕한다고 (징계를 하나)”고 지적했다. 이어 “장동혁처럼 하는 게 당 기강이 안 서는 것이다. 나가야 될 사람이 안 나가고 있는 게 기강이 안 서는 것이다”라며 “무슨 기강은 기강이냐”고 비판했다.)

By Jeon Gwang-joon, light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Expedite anti-stock-suppression law... Why aren't we included in advanced country indices?" (이 대통령 “주가 누르기 방지법 속도 내라…선진국 지수 편입 왜 안 되나”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 15th emphasized the normalization of the stock market, stating, "Legislation like the anti-stock-suppression law hasn't been passed and is being delayed. Get cooperation by any means to speed things up." (이재명 대통령이 15일 주식시장 정상화를 강조하며 “주가 누르기 방지법 등 입법도 안 되고, 지연되고 있다. 어떻게든 협조를 얻어 속도를 내라”고 말했다.)

During a briefing at the presidential office's Yeongbin-gwan on the 15th targeting the Ministry of Finance and Economy (National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, Public Procurement Service), the National Data Agency, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Planning and Budget, President Lee said, "In our society's asset allocation, the proportion of real estate is too large, which is very primitive." He added, "Normalizing the capital market is a very important national policy." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 재정경제부(국세청·관세청·조달청), 국가데이터처, 금융위원회, 기획예산처 대상 업무보고에서 “우리 사회의 자산 배분에서 부동산 비중이 너무 큰 것은 매우 원시적”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “자본시장 정상화가 매우 중요한 국가 정책”이라고 강조했다.)

In the briefing, President Lee directly asked Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy Koo Yoon-cheol about the reasons for the failure to be included in the MSCI Developed Market Index last month. President Lee said, "Our domestic stock market is quite unstable. After such an unprecedented massive surge in such a short period, doesn't it need time and volatility to stabilize?" He added, "Things like MSCI index inclusion could help stabilize the stock market internationally, so why isn't it working out?" (이 대통령은 보고에서 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관에게 모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널(MSCI) 선진국 지수 편입이 지난 달 불발된 이유에 대해 직접 물었다. 이 대통령은 “우리 국내 주식시장이 꽤 불안정하다. 너무 단기간에 정말 역사적으로 있을 수 없는 대폭등을 하다보니까 그게 안정화되려면 시간과 변동이 필요하지 않냐”며 “모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널 지수 편입 같은게 국제적으로 (주식시장) 안정화에 도움이 되는데, 왜 잘 안 되고 있냐”고 했다.)

Deputy Prime Minister Koo responded, "We have our own pace. (The biggest reason for the failure is) the demand to allow 24-hour free trading of the won and free account creation. Since the foreign exchange market isn't ready, exposing it all at once could have adverse effects, so we plan to make significant institutional improvements by early next year." ( 구 부총리는 “우리는 우리 속도가 있다”며 “(불발된 가장 큰 이유는) 원화를 24시간 자유롭게 거래하고 계좌도 자유롭게 만들 수 있도록 해달라는 요구다. 외환시장이 준비가 안 된 상태에서 한꺼번에 노출되면 오히려 역작용이 있을 수 있기 때문에 내년 초까지 좀 많은 제도 개선을 할 것 같다”고 답했다.  )

President Lee also directly asked about measures to normalize the stock market. Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won said, "Since trust is most important in the capital market, we will continue to eradicate stock price manipulation. Next, protecting shareholder value is very important. Following the revision of the Commercial Act and the treasury stock system, we have announced and are gathering opinions on a revision to ban dual listings except for exceptions, which we plan to implement in earnest in July." (이 대통령은 주식시장 정상화를 위한 조처를 직접 묻기도 했다. 이억원 금융위원장은 “자본시장은 신뢰가 제일 중요하기 때문에 주가조작 근절 등은 계속 해 나갈 예정”이라며 “그 다음에 주주가치 보호 이 부분이 굉장히 중요한데, 상법 개정과 자사주 제도에 이어 중복 상장 원칙 금지, 예외 허용 개정안을 발표해서 의견 수렴 중이고, 7월 중에 본격적으로 시행할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Furthermore, Chairman Lee stated, "In the KOSDAQ market, we will expand technology-specific customized listing exceptions to allow innovative companies to enter smoothly, and quickly delist underperforming companies." (또 이 위원장은 “코스닥 시장은 기술형 맞춤형 특례상장을 확대해 혁신기업이 원활하게 들어오게 하고, 부실기업은 신속하게 퇴출하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Han Dong-hoon's Refutation of Ahn Cheol-soo's Dec. 3 Testimony Means Dismantling the People Power Party" (장동혁 “한동훈, 안철수 12·3 증언 반박은 국힘 해산시키겠다는 것”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, acting leader of the People Power Party (PPP), stated on the 15th regarding independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon’s backlash against Rep. Ahn Cheol-soo’s recent court testimony—that it was then-PPP leader Han who first suggested going to the party headquarters during the December 3 martial law crisis—that "Rep. Ahn merely confirmed in court what both lawmakers and I already knew. It's regrettable that Han cannot even refute the facts and keeps attacking only Ahn Cheol-soo." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 15일 최근 안철수 의원의 ‘12·3 비상계엄 때 당사로 먼저 가자고 한 사람은 한동훈 당시 대표’라는 법정 증언에 대해 한동훈 무소속 의원이 반발하는 데 대해 “의원들도 알고 있고 저도 알고 있던 사실을 (안 의원이) 법정에서 확인해 준 것뿐인데 사실관계는 반박도 못 하면서 계속 안철수 의원만 공격해 안타깝다”고 말했다.)

Jang made these remarks while appearing on the YouTube channel "Pen and Mic TV" on the same day, recounting the situation during the December 3 martial law. He emphasized, "I was eating near the National Assembly when I received a text about a general meeting of lawmakers. While heading there, I was suddenly informed that the supreme council meeting had been moved to the party headquarters, so I turned back and went there. I met former leader Han Dong-hoon at the party headquarters, moved together to the main building of the National Assembly, discussed how to handle the general meeting, and then went to the plenary session to vote on lifting martial law. So, I am the person most familiar with this situation." (장 대표는 이날 펜앤마이크 티브이(TV) 유튜브 방송에 출연해 12·3 비상계엄 당시 상황을 전하며 이같이 말했다. 장 대표는 “(비상계엄 당시 국회의사당) 근처에서 식사하다가 의총 소집 문자를 받고 이동하던 중에 갑자기 최고위원회가 당사로 바뀌었다고 해서 발걸음을 돌려서 당사로 갔다”며 “한동훈 전 대표와 당사에서 만나 같이 국회 본청으로 이동했고 의원총회 등을 어떻게 해야 할지 논의하고 제가 본회의장에 가서 (계엄 해제) 표결까지 했었기 때문에 이 상황을 (제가) 가장 잘 알고 있는 사람”이라고 강조했다.)

Jang further questioned, "If Han had clearly stated the facts from the beginning, the public would have realized that the special counsel’s indictment was excessive. Even after Ahn Cheol-soo testified, if Han continues to insist it's wrong, is he saying that Mayor Choo Kyeong-ho of Daegu should be punished as an accomplice to insurrection? Is he trying to paint the PPP as an insurrectionist party and have it dissolved?" He added, "Even lawmakers who previously supported Han Dong-hoon’s reinstatement into the party now see that they have lost any justification for mentioning it. This issue goes beyond misconduct—it is a criminal act. Discussing reinstatement for someone expelled for criminal behavior is itself inappropriate." (장 대표는 “(한 의원이) 사실관계를 진작부터 명확하게 얘기했더라면 특검의 무리한 기소라는 게 모든 국민에게 알려졌을 것”이라며 “안철수 의원이 증언한 다음에도 그게(주장) 계속 틀렸다고 주장한다면 추경호 (대구)시장이 내란죄의 공범으로 처벌을 받으라는 거냐. (그렇게 해서) 국민의힘을 내란정당으로 몰아서 해산시키겠다는 거냐”고 되물었다. 이어 “한동훈 전 대표의 복당을 응원하던 의원들도 이제 한동훈 전 대표의 복당을 언급할 만한 명분을 상실했다고 본다”며 “(한 의원 징계) 문제는 해당 행위를 넘어서서 범죄 행위다. 범죄 행위로 제명당한 사람에 대해서 복당을 이야기하는 것 자체가 적절하지 않다”는 입장을 반복했다.)

Jang also stated, "Han did not have the right to vote on lifting martial law at that time. It was 18 PPP lawmakers who entered the plenary session and voted in favor of lifting martial law. The person (Han) who could not enter the plenary session only came in and shook hands with then-leader Lee Jae-myung." Han was not a lawmaker at the time and thus had no voting rights in the National Assembly. (장 대표는 또 “(한 의원은 당시) 계엄 해제에 대한 표결권도 없다”며 “본회의장에서 가서 같이 계엄해제에 찬성하고 표결한 것은 당시 18명의 (국민의힘) 국회의원이다. 본회의장에 들어올 수 없는 사람(한 의원)이 본회의장에 들어와서 그 당시 이재명 대표하고 악수한 것밖에 없다”고 했다. 한 의원은 당시 국회의원이 아니라 국회 표결권이 없는 상황이었다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the stalled negotiations over forming a new parliamentary leadership, Jang said, "If the negotiations on forming the leadership are not resolved in a way we find acceptable by this Constitution Day, and if no agreement is reached on the special counsel issue, then, despite being the leader of the main opposition party, I will not attend the Constitution Day event." (한편 장 대표는 원 구성 협상에 공회전하는 데 대해 “만약에 이번 제헌절까지 원 구성 협상이 우리가 납득할 만한 방향으로 이뤄지지 않고 특검에 대한 협상도 이루어지지 않는다면 제1야당 대표이지만 이번 제헌절 행사에는 참석하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung: "Professional informants should not face disadvantages… Reporting corruption contributes to the public interest" (이재명 “전문 신고꾼 불이익 없어야…부패 신고는 공익에 기여”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 15th, "I don't think it's bad to make a profession out of uncovering and reporting corruption." (이재명 대통령이 15일 “부정부패를 발굴해서 신고하거나 하는 걸 업으로 하는 것도 나쁘지 않다고 본다”고 말했다.)

During a work report session for the Ministry of Economy and Finance (including the National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, and Public Procurement Service), the National Data Processing Agency, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Strategy and Finance, held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guesthouse, the President said, "There's this atmosphere of 'Are you just reporting bad things about others to get money?' But I believe that reporting and rooting out such issues actually contributes much more to the country or community." He added, "When the government administers reward money, it's better not to disadvantage someone just because they are a 'professional informant.'" <<> The government has announced its plan to revise the enforcement decree of the Subsidy Act by the end of September to expand the criteria for paying reporting rewards. item.title: President Lee: "Quickly Prepare Supplementary Measures" for Samsung and SK Hynix Leveraged ETFs (이 대통령, 삼전닉스 레버리지 ETF “보완 대책 신속하게 마련하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 14th instructed officials to "quickly prepare supplementary measures" regarding leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) tied to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which have been criticized for causing extreme stock market volatility. (이재명 대통령이 14일 극심한 증시 변동성을 초래한다는 지적을 받는 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)와 관련해 “보완 대책을 잘 신속하게 마련하라”고 지시했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a business report session at the Blue House State Guest House, which involved the Ministry of Economy and Finance (including the National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, and Public Procurement Service), the National Data Agency, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Planning and Budget. On the same day, President Lee said to Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin, "It seems you've been taking a lot of heat lately because of the Samsung and SK Hynix ETFs." Governor Lee replied, "As a market regulator, I bear responsibility, and I am accepting it willingly." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 재정경제부(국세청·관세청·조달청), 국가데이터처, 금융위원회, 기획예산처 대상 업무보고에서 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 이찬진 금융감독원장에게 “최근에 삼성 하이닉스 이티에프 때문에 많이 당하고 계신 모양”이라고 말했고, 이 원장은 “시장 관리자로서 저의 책임이 있어서 책임을 달게 받고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Unusual Return Home: Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha Says “Coupang Issue is Lingering Much Longer Than Expected” (이례적 귀국, 강경화 대사 “쿠팡, 생각보다 훨씬 오래 가는 이슈”)
item.description:
South Korea’s ambassador to the United States, Kang Kyung-wha, who made an unusual temporary return home to consult on various issues in the U.S.-ROK relationship, said on the 15th that the Coupang issue is “lingering much longer than I had expected.” <<> While entering the Foreign Ministry building to meet with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, Ambassador Kang told reporters, “We are managing that issue [the Coupang matter] as it is, and we are continuing consultations at various levels to make progress on the items agreed upon by the two leaders in the joint fact sheet [U.S.-ROK summit joint explanatory document].” <<> When asked whether the U.S. side had made specific demands to South Korea, she replied, “There is nothing I can say right now,” adding, “We are continuing the consultations.” <<> Recently, undercurrents of tension have been building between the U.S. and South Korea, including turbulence over the Coupang incident and the Information and Communications Network Act, as well as slower-than-expected progress on security consultations. In particular, the Coupang issue is becoming an increasing burden. <<> In April, 54 Republican members of the U.S. House of Representatives sent a letter to Ambassador Kang calling for “an end to discriminatory regulations against American businesses operating in South Korea.” More recently, a report by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee alleged that the South Korean government is unfairly targeting the American company Coupang. Subsequently, a White House official remarked, “The Yoon Suk Yeol government is singling out Coupang,” making the disagreements over the Coupang issue a growing strain on the overall U.S.-ROK relationship. Minister Cho’s unusual decision to temporarily recall Ambassador Kang is interpreted as a judgment that these conflict factors urgently need to be addressed. <<> In response to a question about whether the U.S. is pressuring South Korea to speed up its investment in America, Ambassador Kang said, “Our Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the U.S. Department of Commerce are continuing their consultations.” She added, “Since we are trying to identify projects that meet commercial viability, it seems that a bit more discussion may be needed.” <<> Ambassador Kang returned to South Korea on the 15th on Minister Cho’s instructions and is scheduled to stay until the 19th, continuing consultations with ministries related to the U.S.-ROK relationship. After meeting privately with Minister Cho to report on and discuss current issues, she is expected to attend meetings on U.S.-ROK relations chaired by the Office of National Security at the presidential office during her stay in Seoul, along with officials from relevant ministries, to exchange views. <<> Ambassador Kang said, “The relationship between the U.S. and South Korea is so close and complex that there are many issues.” She added, “Since the perspective naturally differs between those based in Washington, D.C., and those at headquarters [the Foreign Ministry], I came to listen to headquarters’ thoughts and share my on-the-ground perspective.” <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (한미관계에 산적한 이슈 협의를 위해 이례적으로 일시 귀국한 강경화 주미한국대사가 쿠팡 문제는 “제가 생각했던 것보다는 훨씬 오래 가는 이슈”라고 15일 말했다.)

item.title: First Lady Kim Hye-kyung’s ‘Hand Shaking’ Diplomatic Faux Pas? The Truth Lies in the Context (김혜경 여사 ‘손털기’ 외교 결례?…앞뒤 상황에 진실 있다)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo posted a video of First Lady Kim Hye-kyung shaking hands with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh at a stadium during President Lee Jae-myung’s state visit to Mongolia, followed by her shaking her hand, claiming it was a ‘diplomatic breach of etiquette’. The Democratic Party of Korea countered that the video was ‘fabricated and manipulated fake news’, announcing legal action and demanding an apology. They argued that the video omitted scenes where she shook her hand due to pain from pulling a bowstring before the handshake, calling it a ‘malicious edit.’ <<> In an 11-second video posted on Facebook on the 13th, Joo said, “Using taxpayers’ money to go all the way to Mongolia, what’s with the ‘hand shaking’?” The video shows Kim shaking hands with President Khürelsükh at a traditional archery field in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, on the 11th (local time), then shaking her right hand. <<> In a post accompanying the video, Joo claimed, “Kim Hye-kyung’s hand shaking—did she shake off national dignity and manners as well?” He argued that “right after shaking hands with the Mongolian president, her blatantly shaking her hand in his presence was an absurd outburst that drew harsh criticism.” He added, “This rude behavior toward a foreign head of state on the diplomatic stage is being frozen as evidence, leading to accusations of ‘national humiliation.’ It’s the worst rudeness that dropped South Korea’s national dignity instantly, forgetting the weight of the position of the president’s wife.” <<> According to a YouTube video from the Korea Policy Broadcasting Institute (KTV) showing the situation, after a archery session between President Lee and the Mongolian side, Kim attempted archery. She tried several times to pull the bowstring but, likely due to strong tension, struggled. She then returned the bow to a Mongolian official, shaking her right hand twice as if in pain. At that moment, President Khürelsükh offered a handshake to Kim, and after shaking his hand with her right hand, she shook her hand five more times. <<> Kim later received guidance from the Mongolian side on archery posture and succeeded in partially drawing the bowstring to shoot, then continued shaking her hand, apparently from pain. <<> Joo’s video omits scenes of Kim shaking her hand after pulling the bowstring just before the handshake with President Khürelsükh, as well as after successfully shooting the bow. <<> The Democratic Party responded, “Is Joo a member of the National Assembly or a cyber-rent-a-car?” calling it “clear fake news.” Hwang Myung-sun, a senior Democratic Party member, said at a party meeting on the 15th, “For an ordinary person who has never pulled a bowstring, feeling pain in the hand is perfectly natural. The full video shows her pulling the bowstring and being in pain, but only the hand-shaking scene after the handshake was spliced together and distributed.” He criticized it as “a despicable, malicious manipulation and incitement—a fraud against the public and behavior unbelievable for a member of the National Assembly.” <<> Hwang added, “We will judge Joo Jin-woo’s wrong politics with immediate legal action.” He urged, “If you have even the slightest conscience, apologize to Kim Hye-kyung and the people now and immediately delete the video.” <<> Park Hae-cheol, a Democratic Party spokesperson, also held a briefing on the same day, saying, “This video is clearly maliciously manipulated and edited.” He criticized, “The main opposition party has spread fake news without even checking the facts, engaging in false incitement.” Lee Joo-hee, the party’s deputy floor leader, said in a briefing, “The editing scissors not only cut the video but also cut out the minimal conscience of a public figure who should verify facts.” She urged, “Stop the distribution of the fabricated video immediately and apologize to the public and Kim Hye-kyung.” <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (주진우 국민의힘 의원이 이재명 대통령과 함께 몽골을 국빈 방문한 김혜경 여사가 경기장에서 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령과 악수를 한 뒤 손을 터는 영상을 올리며 ‘외교적 결례’라고 주장했다. 더불어민주당은 “허위·조작 가짜 뉴스 영상을 제작·유포했다”며 법적 조치를 예고하고 사과를 촉구했다. 악수 전 활시위를 당겨 통증 때문에 손을 털었던 모습이 생략된 ‘악의적 편집’이라는 것이다.)

item.title: Jeong Seong-ho: "When Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Powers Are Abolished, Forwarding All Cases Needed as Means to Control Police" (정성호 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지 때 경찰 통제 수단 전건송치 필요”)
item.description:
Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho said on the 15th, "When the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers are abolished, forwarding all cases is necessary as a means to control the police." (정성호 법무부장관은 15일 “검찰 보완수사권이 폐지됐을 때 경찰을 통제할 수 있는 수단으로서 전건송치가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

The Minister stated this during the full session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, saying, "Abolishing supplementary investigations is the government's basic stance." Forwarding all cases is a system where all cases investigated by the police are sent to the prosecution regardless of the conclusion to indict or not, which was abolished during the Moon Jae-in government in 2021. (정 장관은 이날 국회 법사위원회 전체회의에서 “보완수사 폐지는 정부의 기본 입장”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 전건송치는 경찰이 수사한 모든 사건을 기소·불기소 결론과 관계없이 검찰에 송치하는 제도로, 2021년 문재인 정부 때 폐지됐다.)

Minister Jeong rebutted when Rep. Park Eun-jung of the Fatherland Innovation Party pointed out that the prosecution should not be given investigative powers, citing "cases systematically covered up through the prosecution's supplementary investigations, such as the Kim Hak-ui case." He countered, "The truly problematic cases are not those, but rather sex crimes where women are primarily victims, cases involving social vulnerable groups such as child, elderly, and disabled abuse, and fraud crimes targeting social vulnerable groups." He added, "How many cases involve prosecutors or political cases? Currently, the prosecution's requests for reinvestigation in cases that were not forwarded overturn decisions at a rate of about 0.71%. That amounts to several thousand out of hundreds of thousands of cases. Please view the investigative reality coolly and objectively to ensure those victims are not wrongfully treated." (정 장관은 박은정 조국혁신당 의원이 “김학의 사건 등 검찰의 보완수사로 조직적으로 은폐한 사건”을 여럿 언급하며 검찰에 수사권을 주면 안 된다고 지적하자 “정말 문제되는 사건은 그런 사건이 아니라 주로 여성이 피해자인 성범죄들과 아동·노인·장애인 학대 등 사회적 약자 사건, 사회적 약자를 대상으로 한 사기 범죄이다”라고 반박했다. 이어 그는 “검사가 관련된 사건, 정치 사건이 도대체 몇 건이겠느냐”며 “지금 검찰이 불송치 사건에 대해 재수사 요청을 해서 결정을 뒤집는 게 0.71% 정도 된다. 수십만건 중에 몇천건이 넘는다. 그 피해자들이 억울하지 않도록 수사 현실을 좀 냉정하게 객관적으로 봐 달라”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, he said, "The prosecution back when those cases occurred is different from the current prosecution. (In the future), it will be divided into the Public Prosecution Office and the Major Crimes Prosecution Office, so the prosecution cannot independently initiate or cognize investigations. If we take away the prosecution's investigative powers entirely, I am demanding institutional mechanisms that can faithfully protect victims' rights and the basic human rights of the people in that process." (또, “저런 사건이 있었을 때 검찰과 지금 검찰은 다르고, (앞으로) 공소청과 중수청으로 나눠져 검찰은 독자적으로 수사를 개시할 수도 없고 인지할 수도 없다”며 “검찰 수사권 자체를 박탈한다고 하면 그 과정에서 피해자들의 권리와 국민의 기본적 인권이 충실하게 보호될 수 있는 제도적 장치를 저는 요구하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Integrated military academy for Army, Navy, and Air Force considered at Daejeon's 'Jauun-dae' (육·해·공 통합 사관학교, 대전 ‘자운대’에 설립 검토 중)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense is reportedly considering establishing a four-year national military academy that integrates the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies at 'Jauun-dae' in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, an area dense with military educational facilities, as revealed on the 15th. (국방부가 육·해·공군 사관학교를 통합한 4년제 국군사관학교를 군 교육시설이 밀집한 대전 유성구 ‘자운대’에 설립하는 방안을 검토 중인 것으로 15일 알려졌다.)

A ministry official stated, "We plan to publicly explain the basic plan for establishing the national military academy and refine it through opinion-gathering processes such as public hearings and policy briefings." The core of this plan is to consolidate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into one, providing integrated education for cadets from their first to fourth years. Initially, the ministry considered a '2+2 network-type integration' where cadets from all three branches would receive foundational academics and basic military training together in their first two years, then choose an Army, Navy, or Air Force academy for specialized and military training in their last two years. However, to enhance inter-service jointness, they have settled on a 'four-year integrated curriculum at Jauun-dae,' which already hosts institutions like the Army, Navy, and Air Force colleges. (국방부 관계자는 이날 “국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 공개 설명하고, 공청회, 정책설명회 등 의견수렴 과정을 거쳐 구체화해 나갈 예정”이라고 말했다. 이 방안의 뼈대는 육·해·공군 사관학교를 하나로 묶어 생도들을 1학년부터 4학년까지 한 곳에서 통합 교육하는 것이다. 국방부는 애초 육·해·공 사관생도들이 1·2학년 때 함께 기초 학문과 군사기초교육을 받고, 3·4학년 때 육·해·공군 사관학교를 선택해 전문·군사훈련을 받는 ‘2+2 네트워크형 통합’을 고려했으나, 군 간 합동성 강화를 위해 ‘자운대 4년 통합 학제’로 가닥을 잡았다. 자운대에는 육·해·공군 대학 등이 있다.)

The Army, Navy, and Air Force academies are based on the Military Academy Establishment Act, so a separate legislation would be needed to create the national military academy. The ministry is also reportedly considering expanding the national military academy into a comprehensive university by incorporating additional educational institutions such as the Armed Forces Nursing Academy and the Defense Advanced Technology Academy after merging the three service academies. (육·해·공군사관학교는 사관학교설치법에 근거하고 있어, 국군사관학교를 창설하려면 별도 법안을 만들어야 한다. 국방부는 3군 사관학교를 통합 한 뒤 여기에 국군간호사관학교, 국방첨단기술사관학교 등 교육기관까지 더해 국군사관학교를 종합대학으로 키우는 구상도 검토 중인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Kwon Hyuk-chul, reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's Order Leads to Probe into Sanitation Workers' Wages…1,147 Violations Confirmed (이 대통령 지시 ‘환경미화원 임금’ 조사…1147건 위반 확인)
item.description:
The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 15th that a nationwide survey on wage payments to sanitation workers at local governments, conducted under President Lee Jae-myung's directive, found 1,147 cases where appropriate wages were understated in contracts or actual payments were less than the contracted amounts. <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said in a briefing at Cheong Wa Dae's Chunchugwan, "The Ministry of the Interior and Safety inspected a total of 2,462 cleaning service contracts issued by local governments over the past three years to check whether normal compensation for labor was properly paid. The results showed 586 cases of understatement, where appropriate wages were initially reflected too low in contract documents, and 561 cases of underpayment, where actual wages paid were less than the amounts specified in contracts." She also noted that many cases of failing to operate mandatory dedicated accounts for labor costs were confirmed. <<> This comprehensive survey followed President Lee's instruction at a senior secretary meeting on February 19, after receiving a report that some local governments were not properly implementing regulations to ensure appropriate wages for sanitation workers. He ordered, "Conduct an audit or comprehensive survey to thoroughly grasp the actual situation." <<> Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, "The Ministry of the Interior and Safety plans to inform local governments of the survey results and, if violations are confirmed through audits, request disciplinary action against those responsible and impose disadvantages on the relevant companies. Going forward, we plan to consult with the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and the Ministry of Employment and Labor to devise measures for system improvement and strengthened management to prevent similar cases from recurring." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (청와대가 15일 이재명 대통령 지시로 실시된 전국 지방자치단체 환경미화원 임금 지급 실태조사에서 적정임금이 계약서에 과소 반영되거나 계약서상 금액보다 실제 지급된 임금이 적은 사례가 1147건으로 확인됐다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk again opposes Han Dong-hoon's return to the party... "Frustrating that they can't rebut and only attack Ahn Cheol-soo" (장동혁, 한동훈 복당 거듭 반대…“반박 못하고, 안철수만 공격 안타까워”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, on the 15th provided supporting fire for Ahn Cheol-soo's recent court testimony that "the person who first suggested going to the party headquarters during the December 3 martial law was then-leader Han Dong-hoon," and reiterated his opposition to independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's return to the party. <<> Appearing on the Pen & Mike TV YouTube broadcast that day, Leader Jang mentioned the trial of Daegu Mayor Chu Kyung-ho on charges of obstructing the vote to lift martial law, and directly struck at lawmaker Han and his pro-Han faction within the party, saying, "It was just a fact that lawmakers and I already knew, and Ahn confirmed it in court. It's frustrating that they can't rebut the facts and keep attacking only Ahn Cheol-soo." <<> On the 8th, lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo appeared as a witness in the trial of Daegu Mayor Chu and testified, "I understand that the person who first notified People Power Party lawmakers to gather at the party headquarters, not the National Assembly, was then-leader Han Dong-hoon." Jang, who was a supreme council member at the time of the martial law, lent weight to Ahn's claim. Han, however, has pushed back against Ahn's testimony, calling it "false incitement" and saying, "The National Assembly was blocked, so we briefly stayed at the party headquarters." <<> In fact, on the night of the martial law declaration at 11:03 PM, due to the blockade of the National Assembly, the People Power Party leader's office changed the venue for the supreme council meeting from the National Assembly to the party headquarters. Subsequently, then-leader Han moved to the National Assembly with some of the lawmakers gathered at the party headquarters, requesting other party lawmakers to also head to the Assembly. Separately, the authority to convene a general meeting of lawmakers rested with then-floor leader Chu Kyung-ho, who changed the meeting venue three times and is now suspected of obstructing the vote to lift martial law. <<> Leader Jang stated, "Are you saying that lawmaker Han should be remembered as someone who confronted martial law and led the impeachment, achieving something historic, while punishing Mayor Chu Kyung-ho and turning the People Power Party into an insurrectionist party to be dissolved?" He added, "I believe that even the lawmakers who supported former leader Han Dong-hoon's return to the party have now lost the justification to mention his reinstatement," reiterating his opposition to Han's return. <<> Within the party, criticism has emerged over the untimely "martial law debate." Lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek said on YTN Radio that day, "The party is deeply fatigued by internal strife." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 15일 최근 안철수 의원의 ‘12·3 비상계엄 때 당사로 먼저 가자고 한 사람은 한동훈 당시 대표’라는 법정 증언에 지원 사격을 하며 한동훈 무소속 의원의 복당에 거듭 반대 입장을 밝혔다.)

item.title: DP Supreme Council Members Also in ‘Majority Faction War’… Over 10 Likely to Run for 5 Seats (민주 최고위원도 ‘과반 계파전’…5자리에 10여명 출마 유력)
item.description:
With about a month left until the Democratic Party of Korea’s national convention, the factional battle among supreme council candidates is intensifying. So far, 13 individuals have declared or are likely to declare their candidacy for the supreme council election, revealing a clear competitive structure among the camps. (더불어민주당 전당대회를 한 달 여 앞두고 최고위원 출마자들의 계파전이 치열하게 전개되고 있다. 최고위원 선거에는 현재까지 13명이 출마를 선언했거나 출마가 유력한데, 진영 간 경쟁 구도가 뚜렷하게 드러난다.)

As of the 15th, from the camp of former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, Reps. Choi Min-hee and Han Min-soo have expressed their intent to run, and former Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon is also expected to run. Reps. Park Seong-joon, Seo Mi-hwa, and Lee Geon-tae, who are close to Rep. Kim Min-seok, along with former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute Kim Yong, have also thrown their hats into the ring. From Rep. Song Young-gil’s side, Reps. Kim Young-ho and Park Sun-won have declared their candidacies. Additionally, Deputy Policy Committee Chairman Jeong Min-cheol from the 2030 generation, former Director of the Military Human Rights Center Kim Hyung-nam, and lawmaker Im Mi-ae and Gwangmyeong Mayor Park Seung-won, who have a lighter factional color, have also joined the race. Rep. Im Mi-ae announced her candidacy via Facebook on the same day, stating, “I want to create a Democratic Party that is proud and recognized even in Gyeongsangbuk-do.” <<> After the preliminary primary on the 21st, the field will be narrowed down to 8 candidates who will compete in the main primary, where 5 top vote-getters will be selected through a one-person-two-vote system. Since which faction secures a majority on the supreme council will determine the future leadership of the party, there is active “alliance movement” between party power contenders and supreme council candidates. A representative example is Rep. Lee Geon-tae and former Deputy Director Kim Yong declaring their candidacies with the slogan “replace the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership.” <<> Supreme council candidates also engaged in “proxy wars” on the same day. Rep. Han Min-soo appeared on CBS Radio’s “Park Seong-tae’s News Show,” stating, “During former leader Jeong’s one-year term as party leader, there was no so-called party-presidential office conflict,” and criticized, “(The term ‘myeong-cheong conflict’ is) a political ploy to create a frame accusing former leader Jeong of doing self-serving politics and attack him.” <<> In contrast, Rep. Park Seong-joon posted on Facebook, “We are together as one team, Kim Min-seok and Park Seong-joon,” and then sharply remarked on former leader Jeong’s mention during a press conference on the 13th that he “would not run for president,” asking, “Why bring up the presidential election now?” Rep. Choi Min-hee pointedly targeted Rep. Song, who had criticized former leader Jeong, and lashed out, calling it “grotesque language.” <<> Reporter Go Kyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (15일 현재 정청래 전 대표 쪽에서는 최민희·한민수 의원이 출마 뜻을 밝혔고, 이성윤 전 최고위원의 출마도 확실시 된다. 김민석 의원과 가까운 박성준·서미화·이건태 의원, 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장도 출사표를 던진 상태다. 송영길 의원 쪽에선 김영호 의원, 박선원 의원이 출마를 선언했다. 이밖에 2030 세대인 정민철 정책위원회 부의장과 김형남 전 군인권센터 사무국장, 계파색이 옅은 임미애 의원과 박승원 경기 광명시장도 도전장을 내밀었다. 임 의원은 이날 페이스북을 통해 “경북에서도 당당하고 인정받는 민주당을 만들고 싶다”며 출마 의사를 밝혔다.)

item.title: Before the Citizen Participation Panel… President Lee Mentions ‘Chosun Ilbo K2 Article’ Calling it “Nonsense” (국민참여단 앞에서…이 대통령, ‘조선일보 K2 기사’ 거론 “엉터리”)
item.description:
At the presidential office briefing chaired by President Lee Jae-myung on the 15th, a ‘Citizen Participation Panel’ composed of ordinary citizens participated for the first time. (이재명 대통령이 15일 주재한 청와대 업무보고에서는 일반 시민들로 구성된 ‘국민참여단’이 처음 참여했다.)

At the Yeongbin-gwan of the presidential office, where ministry briefings from the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Planning and Budget were held, a separate area was arranged for the 20-member Citizen Participation Panel. The presidential office introduced this with the aim of discussing national policy directions with the people. Starting on the 1st, the presidential office selected 200 members for the Citizen Participation Panel over six days. About 20 of them attend each briefing session. (재정경제부와 기획예산처 등 부처 업무보고가 열린 청와대 영빈관 한쪽에는 20명의 국민참여단을 위한 자리가 별도로 마련됐다. 청와대는 국민과 함께 국정 방향을 논의한다는 취지로 도입했다. 청와대는 지난 1일부터 엿새 동안 200명의 국민참여단을 선발했다. 이들은 업무보고에 20여명씩 매번 참석한다.)

During the meeting, President Lee gave the panel members the floor to speak. A total of five citizens from the panel raised opinions or asked questions to state ministers on topics including △efficient management of public institution personnel △improvement of labor conditions following the 24-hour opening of the foreign exchange market △issues of origin marking forgery and alteration △24-hour operation of a debt crisis self-diagnosis window △and strengthening oversight systems to protect minority shareholders. (이 대통령은 회의에서 참여단에게 발언권을 줬다. 참여단 가운데 총 5명의 시민이 △효율적인 공공기관 인력 운용 △외환시장 24시간 개장에 따른 노동여건 개선 △원산지 위·변조 문제 △채무 위기 자가진단 창구 24시간 운영 △소액주주 보호를 위한 감시체계 강화 등과 관련해 의견을 내거나 국무위원들에게 질문했다.)

President Lee also instructed that the opinions of netizens watching the live broadcast of the briefing be actively introduced. He said, “These are all important opinions from the people, so it will be helpful to refer to them,” adding, “Record them all, distribute them to each ministry, and ensure measures are taken.” (이 대통령은 업무보고 생중계를 보는 누리꾼들의 의견도 적극적으로 소개하라고 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “다 중요한 국민의 의견이니까 참고하면 도움이 된다”며 “다 기록해서 각 부처에 나눠주고 조치하도록 하라”고 했다.)

At the meeting, after hearing a report from National Data Center Director Ahn Hyung-joon on establishing an AI-based article fact-check system, President Lee noted, “Fake news is creating a hostile, confrontational culture that disrupts the entire world and destroys communities,” and mentioned a Chosun Ilbo report from the 13th. Regarding that report, which claimed that most active-duty soldiers cannot use the K2C1 rifle he used during his visit to the Marine Corps Yeonpyeong Unit last month, President Lee criticized it on the 14th, saying, “It’s not a fact-based report but a politically motivated attack based on fabrication.” He added, “It’s a universally issued firearm provided to 170,000 South Korean troops. If fact-checking had been possible, incidents like that nonsensical article attacking the government wouldn’t have occurred.” (회의에서 이 대통령은 인공지능(AI)을 활용한 기사 팩트체크 시스템을 구축하겠다는 안형준 국가데이터처장의 보고를 듣고는 “가짜뉴스가 온 세상을 어지럽히고 공동체를 파괴할 정도의 적대적인, 대결적인 문화를 만들어내고 있다”며 지난 13일치 조선일보 보도를 언급했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 해병대 연평부대를 방문했을 때 자신이 쓴 K2C1 소총을 현역 군인 대다수는 쓰지 못한다고 한 이 보도에 대해 “사실에 기초한 보도가 아니라 조작에 기초한 정치적 공격”이라고 14일 비판했다. 이 대통령은 “대한민국 국군 (장병) 17만명에 지급된 보편화된 총기인데 그런 엉터리 기사를 써서 정부를 공격하는 일들도 팩트체크가 가능하다면 안 생겼을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding public interest whistleblowing, President Lee stated, “I think it’s not bad to make a profession out of uncovering and reporting corruption. Eradicating corruption at its roots through reporting contributes much more to the country. The government should not disadvantage whistleblowers simply because they are professional informants when awarding whistleblower rewards.” In his closing remarks, he advised public officials, “It’s all fine to drink and have fun, but don’t place young members of the opposite sex next to you. Accidents are bound to happen. There should be no mindset that treats others as objects rather than equal individuals.” (이 대통령은 공익신고에 관해서는 “부정부패를 발굴해서 신고하는 걸 업으로 하는 것도 나쁘지 않다고 본다”며 “신고해서 발본색원하는 게 훨씬 더 국가에 기여하는 것이다. 정부가 (신고 포상금을) 집행하는데 너무 전문 신고꾼이라는 이유로 불이익을 주지 않아야 한다”고 말했다. 마무리 발언에선 “술 먹고 노는 거 다 좋은데 옆자리에 젊은 이성을 앉히는 그런 거 하지 마시라. 꼭 사고가 난다”며 “동등한 인격적 주체가 아닌 대상으로 대하는 생각 자체가 없어야 한다”고 공직자들에게 권고했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] UNESCO to Japan, which conceals forced labor: "Address entire history of Sado Gold Mine" ([속보] 유네스코, 강제동원 감추는 일본에 “사도광산 전체 역사 다뤄라”)
item.description:
After the Sado Gold Mine was registered as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2024, Japan has still not acknowledged the history of forced mobilization of Koreans there, and the UNESCO World Heritage Committee has judged that the related historical explanations are "still insufficient." (지난 2024년 사도광산이 유네스코 세계유산으로 등재된 뒤 현재까지도 일본이 이곳의 조선인 강제동원 역사를 인정하지 않는 가운데, 유네스코 세계유산위원회(유산위)는 관련 역사 설명이 “아직 충분하지 않다”고 판단했다.)

According to the draft decision released by the World Heritage Committee on the 15th, the committee stated, "Additional explanation is needed on how the interpretation and exhibition strategies and facilities covering the entire history of the mine development over the full period are comprehensively addressed at the property site," and that "it requests regular reporting on progress to the World Heritage Centre." (세계유산위원회가 15일 공개한 결정문 초안을 보면, 유산위는 “유산 현장에서 광산 개발 전 기간에 걸친 전체 역사에 대한 해설·전시 전략과 시설이 어떻게 종합적으로 다뤄지고 있는지 추가적인 설명이 필요하다”며 “이에 대한 진행 상황을 세계유산센터에 정기적으로 보고할 것을 요청한다”고 밝혔다.)

The committee noted, "While the interpretation and exhibition strategy for the entire history of the property has shown some progress, it is not yet sufficient," and "recommends that the State Party closely consult with relevant parties to comprehensively reflect the full history of the property covering all periods of mine development." Along with these recommendations, the committee demanded that a report on the implementation status be submitted to the World Heritage Centre by December 1, 2027. (유산위는 “유산의 전체 역사에 대한 해설·전시 전략이 일정한 진전을 보였으나 아직 충분하진 않다”며 “관련 당사국과 긴밀 협의해 광산 개발의 모든 시기에 걸친 유산의 전체 역사를 종합적으로 반영하도록 권고한다”고도 했다. 유산위는 이런 권고 사항과 함께 향후 이행 상황에 대한 보고서를 2027년 12월1일까지 세계유산센터에 제출할 것을 요구했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: "The President Doesn't Want Complete Separation of Investigation and Indictment... The Reason Prosecution Reform Isn't Happening" (유시민 “이 대통령이 수사·기소 완전분리 원치 않아…검찰개혁 안 되는 이유”)
item.description:
Author Yoo Si-min said on the 15th regarding the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which will discuss whether to maintain the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority, "The reason prosecution reform hasn't been achieved for over a year is because the president doesn't want a complete separation of investigation and indictment." (유시민 작가가 15일 검찰의 보완수사권 존치 여부를 논의할 형사소송법 개정안과 관련해 “검찰 개혁이 1년이 넘도록 안 이뤄지는 이유는 대통령이 수사·기소 완전 분리를 원하지 않기 때문”이라고 말했다.)

Appearing on the YouTube broadcast 'Maebul Show' that day, Yoo said, "If the president wanted to do it, but the people below are saying things like 'the Minister of Justice did this' or 'the Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs did that,' it's because they're too afraid to face the facts and are trying not to see things clearly." He added, "It's because the president didn't want it, and there can be no other explanation for how we've gotten here." He continued, "Even now, some lawmakers have proposed amendments that preserve part of the supplementary investigation authority, leaving some investigative powers with the prosecution. That's because they know the president's thinking." <<> Yoo also believes that former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's failure to submit the government's prosecution reform proposal regarding supplementary investigation authority to the National Assembly was because "the president prevented him from doing so." He said, "This president made a pledge for complete separation of investigation and indictment in 2022, and again this time (in the 2025 presidential election). After becoming president, he might have thought, 'The police are getting too powerful and there aren't many other checks, so I wish some of it could remain.' If so, he should have sought the public's understanding and handled it responsibly, but instead he had the Minister of Justice do it, the Prime Minister do it, and that's how it's been so far." <<> Regarding the president's style of governing, Yoo said, "I won't say it's the wrong path," but added, "It's a very risky choice for both himself and society. I believe that choice will end in failure." <<> On the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention, he said, "It's not that he didn't say 'Chung Cheong-rae, don't run,' but he made efforts on social media multiple times to boost Prime Minister Kim Min-seok beyond simple compliments. These things aren't legal issues, but they shouldn't be done politically." He also mentioned the June 3 local elections, pointing out, "The president promoting Jeong Won-oh on social media (who ran for Seoul mayor) was an unfair primary. We should have prevented 'Myung-pick' (the president's choice), but there was a lot of interference like that." <<> He also brought up the 'reconstruction theory,' which likens the president's national management, aimed at expanding his base to the center-right and conservatives, to rebuilding. When asked, "Who are the people that make you think the Lee Jae-myung administration is doing reconstruction and redevelopment through personnel appointments?" he replied, "From the Minister of Personnel Innovation to the recently problematic former Vice Chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee, Lee Byung-tae. People like that aren't needed for expansion." <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (유 작가는 이날 유튜브 방송 ‘매불쇼’에 나와 “대통령은 하려고 그러는데 밑에 사람들이 ‘법무부 장관이 어쨌다’, ‘민정수석이 어쨌다’ 이런 것은 사실을 직시하기 너무 두렵기 때문에 사람들이 똑바로 안 보려고 (한 것)”이라며 “대통령이 원하지 않았기 때문에 여기까지 온 것이고 그거 말고 다른 설명 방법이 있을 수 없다”고 말했다. 그는 “지금도 일부 의원들이 일부 (보완수사권을) 살려놓는, 수사권 일부를 검찰에 남겨놓는 법안 개정안을 냈다”며 “대통령 생각을 알기 때문”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "The proportion of real estate in our society's asset allocation is too large, it's primitive" (이 대통령 “우리 사회 자산 배분서 부동산 비중 너무 커 원시적”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 15th instructed "swiftly prepare supplementary measures" regarding the single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, which have faced criticism for increasing stock market instability. (이재명 대통령이 15일 주식시장 불안정성을 키운다는 비판을 받는 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)에 대해 “보완 대책을 신속하게 마련하라”고 지시했다.)

President Lee said this at a business report meeting held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guesthouse, targeting the Ministry of Finance and Economy (National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, Public Procurement Service), National Data Policy Commission, Financial Services Commission, and Ministry of Planning and Budget. Addressing Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Chan-jin, he remarked, "It seems you've been taking quite a hit lately from those Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix ETFs." Governor Lee responded, "As a market regulator, I bear responsibility, and I accept that responsibility willingly." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 재정경제부(국세청·관세청·조달청), 국가데이터처, 금융위원회, 기획예산처 대상 업무보고에서 이찬진 금융감독원장에게 “최근에 삼성전자·에스케이하이닉스 이티에프 때문에 많이 당하고 계신 모양인데”라며 이렇게 말했다. 이 원장은 “시장관리자로서 책임이 있어서 책임을 달게 받고 있다”고 말했다.)

Single-stock leveraged ETFs are products that aim to double the daily return of the underlying stock. Introduced in May with the intention of bringing back leveraged investors from the US and Hong Kong stock markets to the domestic market and stabilizing the won-dollar exchange rate, they have been criticized for amplifying volatility in turbulent markets due to their structure—requiring buying more when prices rise and selling more when they fall. Last month, Governor Lee expressed regret, saying, "I've been reflecting on whether I should have blocked it even if it meant lying down in protest." (단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드는 기초자산의 주가를 2배 쫓아가는 상품이다. 지난 5월 미국·홍콩 증시의 레버리지 투자자들을 국장으로 복귀시켜 원-달러 환율을 잡겠다는 취지 등으로 도입했지만, 오를 땐 더 사고 내릴 땐 더 팔아야 하는 상품 구조 때문에 변동성 장세에서 혼란을 가중시킨다는 지적을 받는다. 이 원장은 지난달 이 상품을 “‘드러누워서 막았어야 했나’라고 반성하고 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee noted, "The domestic stock market is quite unstable. After such a historically unprecedented surge in such a short period, isn't it natural that time and fluctuations are needed for stabilization?" He also asked, "Why is it not going well, when things like inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets Index Watch List could help with stabilization?" (이 대통령은 “국내 주식시장이 꽤 불안정하다. 너무 단기간에 역사적으로 있을 수 없는 대폭등을 하다 보니 그게 안정화되려면 시간과 변동이 필요하지 않냐”며 “모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널(MSCI) 선진국지수 관찰대상국 편입 같은 게 안정화에 도움이 되는데 왜 잘 안되느냐”고 묻기도 했다.)

In addition, President Lee stated, "The fact that real estate accounts for such a large portion of our society's asset allocation is very primitive. Normalizing the capital market is a crucial national policy." He urged, "Speed up the legislation of measures like the 'Stock Price Suppression Prevention Act' as much as possible." The 'Stock Price Suppression Prevention Act' refers to proposed amendments to inheritance tax and gift tax laws aimed at preventing tactics where major shareholders or owner families of some listed companies deliberately keep stock prices low to reduce inheritance and gift taxes during succession. (아울러 이 대통령은 “우리 사회 자산 배분에서 부동산 비중이 너무 큰 것은 매우 원시적이다. 자본시장 정상화가 매우 중요한 국가 정책”이라며 “‘주가 누르기 방지법’ 등의 입법도 어떻게든 속도를 내라”고 주문했다. ‘주가 누르기 방지법’은 일부 상장회사 대주주나 오너 일가가 승계 과정에서 상속·증여세를 덜 내려고 주가를 의도적으로 낮게 유지하려는 꼼수를 막으려 발의된 상속세, 증여세법 개정안 등을 일컫는 말이다.)

President Lee also advocated for proactive debt relief, saying, "If you have debt and no ability to repay, it's socially beneficial to allow bankruptcy and discharge, letting them start over." (이 대통령은 “빚을 졌는데 갚을 능력이 없으면 파산·면책하고 다시 재출발시키는 게 사회적으로 도움이 된다”며 적극적으로 빚을 탕감하는 방안도 주문했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)
