item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk stakes political life in Gwangju but only two lawmakers join (장동혁, 광주서도 “정치생명 걸겠다” 장외전…참여 의원은 2명뿐)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk visited the Gwangju Special Metropolitan City on the 15th to call for a re-election in the June 3 local elections, continuing his nationwide outdoor campaign. Although he is striving to appeal to hardline party supporters by vowing to "stake his political life," the low participation of party lawmakers is undermining his efforts. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 15일 전남광주통합특별시를 찾아 6·3 지방선거 재선거를 촉구하는 등 전국 장외 행보를 이어가고 있다. “정치 생명을 걸겠다”며 강성 당심 공략에 안간힘을 쏟고 있지만, 당 의원들의 참여가 저조해 힘이 실리지 않는 모양새다.)

At 7 p.m. that day, Jang attended a rally titled "June 3 Suffrage Deprivation Incident" held in front of the Gwangju Special City Election Commission. Holding a sign reading "Stealing ballots is real insurrection!!! Lee Jae-myung is the insurrection leader," Jang said, "I am ashamed of the People Power Party and myself as its leader for being unable to gather and unite those voices into a single force just because their thoughts and slogans are a bit different." He added, "So now, I hope we unite all citizens who say they will reclaim their precious votes with one voice and fight an even greater battle from now on." He emphasized, "You are the June 3 citizen revolutionary army defending the Republic of Korea's suffrage and democracy," and "I am willing to stake my political life on protecting the people's precious votes." Jang also appeared choked up, saying, "If there is ever a moment in our lives when we must be angry, and a time when we must answer history's call and risk our lives, today is that moment." <<> Only two party lawmakers attended the event: PPP Jeonbuk Provincial Committee Chairwoman Jo Bae-sook and Party Leader's Office Chief Park Jun-tae. At the previous outdoor rally in Busan on the 12th, only two of the 17 regional lawmakers—Cho Seung-hwan and Lee Heon-seung—participated. A second-term lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh* that day, "We're getting calls from the party leader's side encouraging participation, but as a mainstream politician, going outdoors requires caution, so I'm not going." (장 대표는 이날 오후 7시 광주특별시 선거관리위원회 앞에서 열린 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태 집회’에 참석했다. ‘투표용지 빼돌린 게 진짜 내란!!! 이재명이 내란수괴’라는 손팻말을 들고나온 장 대표는 “생각과 구호가 조금 다르다고 그 목소리들을 하나로 담아내지 못하고 하나된 힘으로 묶어내지 못한 국민의힘과 당대표인 제가 부끄럽다”며 “그래서 이제 우리가 하나의 목소리로 내 소중한 한 표를 찾겠다고 하는 시민 모두를 하나로 묶어서 지금부터 더 큰 싸움을 해 나갔으면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이어 “여러분들이 대한민국의 참정권을 지키고 민주주의를 지켜내는 6·3 시민 혁명군”이라며 “국민들의 소중한 한 표를 지키는 것에 제 정치 생명을 걸려고 한다”고 강조했다. 장 대표는 “우리가 인생을 살면서, 딱 한 번 분노해야 할 때가 있다면, 그리고 역사의 부름을 받고 목숨을 던져야 할 때가 있다면 저는 바로 오늘이 그때”라며 울컥하는 모습을 보이기도 했다.)

Having visited Incheon on the 8th and Busan on the 12th, Jang attended his third rally in a week. He plans to skip the Constitutional Day ceremony on the 17th if negotiations on the formation of the Assembly and a special counsel for the National Election Commission are not concluded, and instead rally supporters at the Olympic Park protest site. (이 자리에는 당 소속 의원으로는 국민의힘 전북도당위원장인 조배숙 의원과 박준태 당대표 비서실장만 참석했다. 지난 12일 부산 장외 집회에서는 지역 의원 17명 중 조승환·이헌승 의원 2명만 참석했다. 한 재선 의원은 이날 한겨레에 “당대표 쪽에서 참여 독려 연락을 받고 있지만, 제도권 정치인이 장외로 나가는 건 신중해야 한다는 입장이라 나가지 않고 있다”고 했다.)

Jang's intense focus on outdoor rallies is seen as an effort to consolidate his support base among hardline party members and quell growing calls for his resignation within the party. Criticism within the PPP against Jang is mounting. Five-term lawmaker Kwon Young-se said on CBS radio that day, "Rather than reforming the party, the leader is roaming outside holding outdoor rallies. No one in the party knows what he's doing there." He criticized, "Focusing solely on external activities is a big problem for building a foundation to win general and presidential elections." (장 대표는 지난 8일 인천, 12일 부산을 방문한 데 이어 일주일 사이 세번째 집회 현장을 찾았다. 오는 17일 제헌절에는 원 구성과 선거관리위원회 특검 협상이 마무리되지 않으면 제헌절 기념식에도 불참하고, 올림픽공원 시위 현장에서 총결집을 유도한다는 계획이다.)

Lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek also appeared on YTN radio that day, saying, "Some seem to think that engaging in outdoor struggles at a time when we should be confronting the Democratic Party in the Assembly is ill-timed." He added, "We need to expand our appeal to centrist voters, and we should heed concerns that the leader's actions might actually alienate them." (장 대표가 장외 집회에 열을 올리는 것은 자신의 지지 기반인 강성 당원을 결집해 당내에서 쏟아지는 사퇴론 등을 잠재우기 위한 행보로 풀이된다. 당내에선 장 대표를 겨냥한 비판이 거세지고 있다. 5선 권영세 의원은 이날 시비에스(CBS) 라디오에서 “장 대표는 당의 개혁보다도 바깥으로 돌아다니며 장외 집회를 하고 있다. 거기서 뭘 하는지 당은 아무도 모른다”며 “장외로만 도는 건 총선과 대선에 승리할 기반을 만드는 데 있어 큰 문제”라고 비판했다.)

Jang Na-re, reporter: wing@hani.co.kr (곽규택 의원도 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오에 출연해 “원내에서 민주당과 대립각을 세워야 되는 시기에 장외 투쟁하는 것이 시기상으로 맞나 하는 생각을 하는 분들이 있는 것 같다”며 “중도층으로 외연 확장을 해야 하는 상황인데 (장 대표의 행보가) 오히려 중도층에 거부감을 주지 않을까 하는 우려를 귀담아들어야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: Unified Selection of Army, Navy, and Air Force Cadets May Be Possible from the 2028 Academic Year (육·해·공 ‘통합 생도’ 선발, 2028학년도부터 가능할 듯)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense is expected to unveil a plan on the 16th following a ruling party-government consultation meeting to establish a new 'National Defense Military Academy' integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, to be located at 'Jauun-dae' in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, an area dense with military educational facilities. (국방부가 육·해·공군 사관학교를 통합한 ‘국군사관학교’를 새로 만들어 군 교육 시설이 밀집한 대전 유성구 ‘자운대’에 설립하는 방안이 16일 당정협의회 뒤 공개될 예정이다.)

The most attention is focused on the academic system and the location of the National Defense Military Academy. The Ministry of National Defense is reportedly strongly considering a plan where all cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force, selected through a unified process, would be educated together at Jauun-dae for four years. This is not the previously known '2+2 network-type integration' where cadets receive common education in their first and second years and then choose their respective service branch for specialized major education in their third and fourth years, but rather a plan for integrated education at a single location for all four years. This approach aligns with the ideal of ensuring educational continuity and the jointness among the services, which is the purpose of integrating the military academies, and also fits the local-led growth emphasized by the Lee Jae-myung administration. (가장 관심이 쏠리는 것은 학제와 국군사관학교의 위치다. 국방부는 국군사관학교를 신설해 통합 선발된 육·해·공군 생도 모두가 4년간 자운대에서 함께 교육받는 방안을 유력하게 검토하는 것으로 알려졌다. 지금까지 알려진 1·2학년 때는 함께 공통교육을 받고, 3·4학년엔 육·해·공군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 하는 ‘2+2 네트워크형 통합’이 아니라 4년 동안 한곳에서 통합교육 하는 방안이다. 교육의 연속성과 사관학교 통합의 취지인 각 군의 합동성을 살리는 이상적인 방안이고, 이재명 정부가 강조하는 지방주도 성장에도 부합한다.)

However, this plan would require relocating the current Naval Academy (Jinhae-gu, Changwon-si, Gyeongnam) and Air Force Academy (Cheongju-si, Chungbuk) to Daejeon. This raises concerns about the burden of massive relocation costs and potential opposition from local communities. If this policy is finalized, not only Army Academy alumni but also Navy and Air Force Academy alumni may actively engage in anti-integration movements. (하지만 이 방안은 현재 해군사관학교(경남 창원시 진해구)와 공군사관학교(충북 청주시)를 대전으로 이전해야 한다. 대규모 이전 예산 부담과 지역사회 반발이 예상되는 대목이다. 이 방침이 결정되면 육군사관학교(육사) 예비역뿐만 아니라 해군사관학교(해사)·공군사관학교(공사) 출신 예비역들도 통합 반대 운동에 적극 나설 가능성이 있다.)

The government is reportedly considering a plan to launch the National Defense Military Academy at the current Seoul Army Academy site starting from the 2028 academic year, and then move it to Jauun-dae around 2032 when school facilities are completed. In this case, cadet selection may be possible starting from the current second year of high school. After integration, the Air Force and Naval academies are expected to be used as service-specific specialized training facilities. After the move to Jauun-dae, the Seoul Army Academy site will be closed. (정부는 국군사관학교를 2028학년도부터 서울 육사 터에서 출범시킨 뒤 자운대에서 학교 시설이 완공되는 2032년께 이전하는 방안을 검토하는 것으로 알려졌다. 이 경우 생도 선발은 현재 고등학교 2학년부터 가능할 것으로 보인다. 통합 이후 공사, 해사는 군별 전문 교육 시설로 활용될 것으로 알려졌다. 자운대로 이전 뒤 서울의 육사는 문을 닫게 된다.)

The government aims to eventually develop the National Defense Military Academy beyond a tri-service integrated academy into a comprehensive university that oversees officer training institutions. The government is considering a three-phase approach: Phase 1—integration of Army, Navy, and Air Force academies; Phase 2—integration of the National Defense Nursing Academy and the National Defense Advanced Science and Technology Academy at Jauun-dae; and Phase 3—establishment of ROTC and Officer Candidate School (OTS) programs and creation of doctoral programs (National Defense Science and Technology Graduate School). (정부는 향후 국군사관학교를 3군 통합 사관학교를 넘어 장교 양성 기관을 총괄하는 종합대학교로 키우는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 정부는 1단계 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합→2단계 자운대에 있는 국군간호사관학교와 국방첨단과학기술사관학교 등의 통합→3단계 학군·학사장교 교육과정 설치 및 박사과정(국방과학기술대학원) 신설 방안을 고려하고 있다.)

If the Jauun-dae integration plan is finalized, the possibility of relocating the Army Academy to Jangseong, South Jeolla—which had faced strong opposition from the Army Academy Alumni Association—will disappear. However, the Army Academy Alumni Association continues to oppose it. (자운대 통합 방안이 결정되면 애초 육군사관학교 총동창회 등에서 강하게 반발했던 ‘육사 전남 장성 이전’ 가능성은 사라지지만 육사 총동창회는 반발하고 있다.)

An official from the Army Academy Alumni Association said in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh*, "Whether it's moving to Jangseong, South Jeolla, or conducting four-year integrated education at Jauun-dae, both plans are predicated on closing the current Army Academy in Seoul and relocating it to a provincial area. Our stance remains unchanged: opposing the hasty integration of military academies and opposing the relocation of the Army Academy to a provincial area." (육사 총동창회 관계자는 한겨레와 한 통화에서 “전남 장성으로 가든 자운대에서 4년 통합교육을 하든 현재 서울에 있는 육사가 문을 닫고 지방으로 옮기는 것을 전제로 하는 방안이다. 사관학교 졸속 통합 반대, 육사 지방 이전 반대란 주장은 변함없다”고 말했다.)

In response, Seo Nam-yeol, chairman of the National Defense & Security Forum (Army Academy Class 40, retired colonel), said, "While I understand emotionally the alumni's desire to protect their alma mater, the combat environment is changing so rapidly with the emergence of AI that it has become an urgent task to cultivate new officers capable of responding to future warfare. We must not miss the golden time for reforming military academy education." (이에 대해 서남열 국방안보포럼 회장(육사 40기·예비역 대령)은 “육사 출신의 모교 지키기는 심정적으로 이해는 가지만 인공지능 등장 등 전장 환경이 숨 막힐 정도로 급변하고 있어 미래전에 대응할 새로운 장교 양성이 절박한 과제가 됐다”며 “사관학교 교육 개혁의 골든타임을 놓치지 말아야 한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyeok-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Caution over Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Sparks Backlash from Pro-Jeong Cheong-rae Faction: “Don’t Be Fooled” (보완수사권 폐지 신중론에…친청계 “속지 말라” 거센 반발)
item.description:
As cautious voices within the Democratic Party of Korea emerge regarding the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers, strong opposition is intensifying, particularly from the pro-Jeong Cheong-rae faction. Amid ongoing internal conflicts over whether to maintain or abolish these powers, subtle shifts in the atmosphere are also being detected. (더불어민주당 내에서 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 신중론이 고개를 들자 친청(정청래)계를 중심으로 거센 반발이 이어지고 있다. 보완수사권 존폐를 둘러싼 내부 갈등이 이어지는 가운데 미묘한 분위기 변화도 감지된다.)

Senior Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok wrote on Facebook on the 15th, “Recently, there have been moves within the party to blur the purpose of abolishing supplementary investigation powers or effectively retreat from it,” adding, “If we allow (prosecution reform) to be shaken or derailed again by conflicting interests and arguments within the party, the Democratic Party will bear a heavy responsibility before history.” Former Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun also stated, “We must absolutely not be fooled,” and “Whether it’s ‘supplementation,’ ‘reduction,’ or ‘alternatives,’ leaving any investigative powers to the prosecution means failure of prosecution reform.” At the general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers held the previous day, Rep. Hong Gi-won, who proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that exceptionally allows the prosecution direct supplementary investigation powers, along with nine others, publicly stated that “a cautious approach is needed toward the full abolition of supplementary investigation powers.” Rep. Choi Min-hee responded by writing, “Yesterday at the general meeting, I listened carefully to the statements by Reps. Hong Gi-won, Park Gyun-taek, and Ko Min-jung,” and “In my judgment, Rep. Hong Gi-won’s proposed bill was one that perpetuates the prosecution’s investigative powers.” (문정복 최고위원은 15일 페이스북에 “최근 당내 일각에서 보완수사권 폐지의 취지를 흐리거나 사실상 후퇴시키려는 움직임이 보인다”며 “(검찰개혁을) 당내의 엇갈린 이해와 주장으로 다시 흔들거나 좌초시킨다면, 민주당은 역사 앞에 큰 책임을 지게 될 것”이라고 적었다. 이성윤 전 최고위원도 “절대 속아서는 안 된다”며 “‘보완’ ‘축소’ ‘대안’이든 무엇이든 검찰의 수사권을 남겨두는 것은 검찰개혁의 실패”라고 했다. 전날 열린 민주당 의원총회에서는 예외적으로 검찰의 직접 보완수사권을 허용하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 홍기원 의원 등 10명이 ‘보완수사권 전면 폐지에 신중해야 한다’고 공개 발언했다. 최민희 의원은 이에 대해 “어제 의총에서 홍기원·박균택·고민정 의원 등의 발언을 경청했다”며 “제 판단엔 홍기원 의원 대표발의 법안은 검찰 수사권 존치법안이었다”고 썼다.)

The previous day, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae shared an article reflecting the atmosphere of that general meeting, writing, “Why has the mood suddenly become like this… It’s depressing.” The post was met with comments listing the names and constituencies of lawmakers who signed onto Rep. Hong Gi-won’s bill. Pressure-filled comments also followed, such as “Let’s launch a campaign to vote them out” and “Let’s eliminate them all in the candidate nominations.” A lawmaker who participated in proposing the bill told The Hankyoreh, “Many attacking comments were posted on Facebook, and I’ve been receiving a lot of text messages raising issues with the bill since yesterday,” and added, “It feels like they’re targeting us.” Pro-caution Rep. Kim Nam-hee, speaking on SBS Radio that day, pointed out, “Some lawmakers are trying to use supplementary investigation powers as a political tool,” and “They are using the abolition of supplementary investigation powers as a tool to appeal to hardline party members, which is inappropriate conduct for a politician.” (전날 정청래 전 대표가 이런 의총 분위기가 담긴 기사를 공유하고 “갑자기 왜 이런 분위기가 됐는지…우울합니다”라고 적은 글에는 홍기원 의원 안에 서명한 의원들의 이름과 지역구가 적힌 댓글이 달렸다. 이들을 향해 ‘낙선 운동을 벌이자’ ‘공천 때 다 날리자’ 같은 압박성 댓글도 따라붙었다. 법안 발의에 참여한 한 의원은 한겨레에 “페이스북에 공격하는 댓글이 많이 달렸고, 어제부터 (법안에 대한 문제 제기) 문자를 많이 받고 있다”며 “좌표를 찍는 것이 아닌가”라고 말했다. 신중론 쪽에 선 김남희 의원은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에서 “보완수사권을 일종의 정치적 도구로 활용하려는 의원들도 있다”며 “보완수사권 폐지를 강성 당원들에게 소구하고자 하는 도구로 이용하는데, 정치인으로서 부적절한 행위”라고 지적했다.)

Amid the party’s once-dominant opinion favoring the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers, cautious voices are gradually emerging. Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won, appearing on YTN Radio’s “Jang Seong-cheol’s News Myeongdang” that day, said, “In the case of Jang Yun-gi, issues related to the investigation of crimes against the socially vulnerable, youth, women’s sexual crimes, and crimes against the disabled have come to the fore. It is right to retain supplementary investigation powers for such crimes,” adding, “So I too have revised my stance (from full abolition to partial retention).” When asked by the host whether “the majority sentiment within the party is leaning toward the view that an exceptional provision recognizing supplementary investigation powers should be included,” Rep. Park responded, “I believe it’s leaning that way.” (보완수사권 완전 폐지 의견이 지배적이던 당내 분위기 속 신중론은 서서히 고개를 들고 있다. 5선 박지원 의원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “장윤기 사건으로 (보완수사권 폐지 때) 사회적 약자, 청소년, 여성 성범죄, 장애인 범죄(수사 문제)가 부각된다. 이런 범죄에 대해서는 보완수사권을 갖는 것이 옳다”며 “그래서 저도 (완전 폐지 의견을 일부 존치로) 수정했다”고 말했다. 박 의원은 ‘예외적으로 보완수사권을 인정하는 조항을 둬야 한다는 쪽으로 당내 다수의 분위기가 잡혀가고 있냐’는 진행자 물음에 “그렇게 잡혀간다고 본다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party held both the first subcommittee and the full session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day to discuss revisions to the Criminal Procedure Act. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho attended the full session and stated, “It is important to ensure that not even 1% of victims suffer injustice,” adding, “Please create a system with such detail that victims’ rights can be guaranteed to the greatest extent possible.” (민주당은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 1소위원회와 전체회의를 각각 열고 형사소송법 개정안을 논의했다. 정성호 법무부 장관은 전체회의에 출석해 “억울한 1%의 피해자가 없도록 하는 게 중요하다”며 “피해자의 권리가 최대한 보장될 수 있도록 세밀하게 제도를 만들어달라”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Convention Approaches, Disagreements over Merger with Innovation Party… Kim Min-seok ‘Hesitant’, Jeong Cheong-rae ‘Positive’ (민주 전대 앞, 혁신당 합당 이견…김민석 ‘유보’ 정청래 ‘긍정’)
item.description:
Major candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea ahead of its August 17 convention are showing differences in opinion on the direction and method of a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party. Attention is being paid to whether the issue of merging with the Innovation Party, which sharply divides party opinions, will become a key point of contention at the convention. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 유력 당대표 후보들이 조국혁신당과의 합당 방향과 방식을 두고 견해차를 보이고 있다. 당내 의견이 뚜렷이 갈리는 혁신당과의 합당 의제가 전당대회의 쟁점으로 떠오를지 주목된다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced the ‘Democratic Party’s Four Major Innovation Plans’ at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 15th, listing ‘pursuing a winning grand unity’ as one of them and presenting three principles for merging with the Innovation Party. He stated, “If approval from Democratic Party members, approval from Innovation Party members, and maintaining the Democratic Party’s name and identity—all three conditions are met, then a merger is possible,” but added, “If even one of these conditions is not met, then we can cooperate instead.” While not denying the necessity of a merger itself, he signaled a reluctance to prioritize it by setting the condition of ‘maintaining the party name and identity.’ <<> In contrast, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae expressed a stance of quickly beginning discussions on a merger if elected party leader. During his candidacy declaration on the 13th, he said, “I regret not being able to hold a vote of all party members (when proposing a merger in January),” and added, “If I become party leader, I will ask for opinions on the merger through a vote of all party members.” <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil is opposed to a merger. In an interview with YTN Radio’s ‘News Face-off with Lee Dong-hyung’ on the 13th, he stated, “I oppose a merger right now,” and noted, “When the general election comes, we can decide whether to merge based on the situation, but then I think we can form an electoral alliance.” <<>
The differing ‘temperatures’ among former PM Kim, former Representative Jeong, and Lawmaker Song regarding a merger with the Innovation Party stem from the different party member bases they are trying to appeal to. Former Representative Jeong is focusing on rallying the traditional Democratic Party support base, which is favorable to a merger. In contrast, former PM Kim and Lawmaker Song are emphasizing expanding the party’s outreach. <<> Amid this, the rival Innovation Party is not hiding its discomfort. Representative Shin Jang-sik, the sole candidate for party leadership in the Innovation Party’s July 25 convention, wrote on Facebook the previous day, “I hope they would show basic respect and courtesy toward our party,” adding, “I will focus on self-strengthening first. I think it’s premature to talk about a merger right now.”
<<> Meanwhile, in an interview on MBC Radio’s ‘Kim Jong-bae’s Focus’ on the same day, Lawmaker Song criticized former Representative Jeong for saying the previous day that the Democratic Party should have not fielded a candidate in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek Gap National Assembly seat, where Fatherland Innovation Party leader Cho Kook is running. Song said, “That’s extremely irresponsible. It’s like saying to your own son, ‘I should have aborted you (instead of giving birth to you)—it’s the same thing.” Even when the host pointed out, “That analogy is a bit off,” Song continued, “It’s just the same.” Song also remarked, “It feels like (former Representative Jeong) is somewhat looking down on the president.” In response, pro-Jeong lawmaker Choe Min-hee criticized Song on Facebook, saying, “Candidate Song Young-gil, after going on about ‘stalker,’ ‘traitor,’ ‘cut off the head,’ ‘suppression,’ now he’s going on about ‘abortion.’” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김민석 전 국무총리는 15일 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사에서 ‘민주당 4대 혁신안’을 발표하고, 그 가운데 하나로 “이기는 대통합 추진”을 꼽으며 혁신당과의 ‘합당 3대 원칙’을 제시했다. 그는 “민주당원의 찬성, 혁신당원의 찬성, 그리고 민주당 당명과 정체성 유지. 이 세가지 조건이 다 맞으면 합당할 수 있다”면서도 “세가지 조건 중 하나라도 맞지 않으면 그때는 연대하면 된다”고 말했다. 합당의 필요성 자체를 부인하지는 않았지만, ‘당명과 정체성 유지’를 조건으로 걸며 합당을 최우선으로 추진하진 않겠다는 뜻을 내비친 것이다. )
